## Výsledok dual review 2026-07-22

### Fyzikálny scope reviewer

`RECOMMEND_AUTHOR_FIRST_A_EXIT_REHEATING_RESERVOIR`, pretože:

1. A je priamo napojená na prežívajúci koridor skorého ukončeného reliktu
   a neskorého takmer čistého `F -> C`;
2. neprázdnosť hladkej pozitívnej efektívnej FLRW triedy bola už
   konštruktívne ukázaná;
3. B navyše nemá definovanú elementárnu udalosť, energiu jazvy, invariantnú
   mieru, `T_I^(mu nu)` ani branch ratio.

A ani B nie sú P2-ready. Odporúčanie A nie je výber mechanizmu za autora.
Ak autor už má konkrétny lokálny zákon jazvy/eventu, môže výslovne zvoliť B.
Pre A musí autor potvrdiť všetkých 11 rozhodovacích blokov uvedených v
dokumente 244: šesť vetvových bodov A a päť spoločných povinných vstupov.

### Documentation steward

Jediný autoritatívny next action je získať autorovu explicitnú voľbu A/B a
rozsah dodaných fyzikálnych vstupov. Našli sa tri stale vrstvy, ktoré sa
opravia jedným batchom až spolu s autorovou voľbou:

1. A2-K4 `00_WORK_PLAN.md` ešte ukazuje historický KMPC-036/CDI next krok;
2. P5 `00_WORK_PLAN.md` ešte ukazuje starý C3 kontrakt a S-C/S-M voľbu;
3. current plan má starú trojrolovú agentovú mapu namiesto odkazu na project
   operating system.

Po samotnom názve vetvy platí
`AUTHOR_BRANCH_SELECTED / INPUT_CONTRACT_INCOMPLETE / NO_CODE`. Po úplnom
vstupe vznikne jeden immutable author-input dokument a najviac štyri
centrálne aktualizácie. Dokument 244 sa neprepisuje.

### Nonclaims

- `FILES_CHANGED_BY_REVIEWERS=0`;
- `PYTHON_PROCESSES=0`;
- bez nového kernelu, rovnice, parametra alebo výpočtu;
- bez zmeny C3, K4, P5, prediction table, release alebo externého auditu.

CORRECTED_FIXED_EVALUATION_SETUP:
  For each Z in D_SV and each deltaZ in T_Z(D_SV), let W[Z] be the allowed
  oriented parent causal worldtube and let
    g_Z[deltaZ] in Omega^3(boundary W[Z]),
    F_Z[deltaZ] in Omega^4(W[Z])
  be the complete field-space-linear boundary and bulk targets frozen by
  task502, including every metric, embedding, moving-boundary, owner,
  orientation, source and geometry term. Define the evaluation map
    ev_(Z,deltaZ): NatLoc_lin(J_allowed) -> Omega^3(W[Z]),
    ev_(Z,deltaZ)(mathcal K)=mathcal K[Z;deltaZ].

POINTWISE_GEOMETRIC_FIBER:
  Face compatibility is required before the integral test. On every
  connected component W_a[Z], define
    O_a[Z;deltaZ]
      = integral_(W_a[Z]) F_Z[deltaZ]
        - integral_(boundary W_a[Z]) g_Z[deltaZ].
  The fixed-evaluation fiber is
    A_geom(Z,deltaZ)=empty
  if face compatibility fails or any O_a[Z;deltaZ] is nonzero. Otherwise,
  for any one smooth geometric solution K0[Z;deltaZ],
    A_geom(Z,deltaZ)
      = K0[Z;deltaZ] + Z_rel^3(W[Z]),
    Z_rel^3(W[Z])
      ={eta in Omega^3(W[Z]):
          i_boundary^*eta=0 and d eta=0}.
  Modulo relative-exact shifts, each nonempty fixed-evaluation fiber is an
  affine torsor over H^3(W[Z],boundary W[Z]). This statement is pointwise
  in field space and does not itself construct a natural operator.

GLOBAL_OPERATOR_LEVEL_PHYSICAL_ALLOWED_SET:
  Let NatLoc_lin(J_allowed) be the single frozen space of covariant,
  field-space-linear, finite-jet local-natural differential operators with
  the contract units and no new field or scale. Define
    mathfrak A_K
      ={mathcal K in NatLoc_lin(J_allowed):
          for every Z in D_SV and every deltaZ in T_Z(D_SV),
          ev_(Z,deltaZ)(mathcal K) in A_geom(Z,deltaZ),
          pure-relabel guard holds,
          KERNEL_COMPAT_CT holds on the combined full-jet kernel,
          G_K(Pi_CT) holds,
          and every task502 causal, regularity, source and ownership guard
          holds}.
  This is a set of objects of one mathematical type. It is not the product
  of pointwise fibers and no section of those fibers is presumed natural.

GLOBAL_HOMOGENEOUS_AFFINE_FREEDOM:
  If one global operator mathcal K0 in mathfrak A_K exists, then
    mathfrak A_K = mathcal K0 + mathfrak Z_loc,
  where
    mathfrak Z_loc
      ={mathcal H in NatLoc_lin(J_allowed):
          for every Z and deltaZ,
          i_boundary^*ev_(Z,deltaZ)(mathcal H)=0,
          d ev_(Z,deltaZ)(mathcal H)=0,
          and all homogeneous relabel, combined-kernel, covariance,
          causality, regularity and source guards hold}.
  Relative-exact equivalence may quotient this global homogeneous operator
  space only when the primitive is itself in the same allowed local-natural
  operator class. No representative, cohomology class, midpoint,
  minimum-norm element or null direction is selected.

CORRECTED_SET_VALUED_DOWNSTREAM_RANGE:
  Define the physical boundary-power image from global operators only:
    A_Pboundary(Z)
      ={beta_mathcalK[Z](D_u Z): mathcal K in mathfrak A_K}.
  Then preserve the entire ledger fiber for every allowed p:
    A_res_set(Z)
      = union_(p in A_Pboundary(Z))
          {x0(p,P_rec)+alpha*v_alpha+beta*v_beta+gamma*v_gamma:
           all frozen guards hold},
    x0(p,P_rec)=(p-P_rec,0,0,P_rec,0)^T,
    v_alpha=(0,1,0,-1,0)^T,
    v_beta=(0,0,1,-1,0)^T,
    v_gamma=(-1,0,0,0,1)^T.
  The rank-2/nullity-3 result is unchanged. beta_mathcalK is derived from
  the same global mathcal K and is not an independently adjustable channel.

CURRENT_CORPUS_EVALUATION:
  The accepted corpus supplies the pointwise target templates and the exact
  geometric obstruction theorem, but supplies neither one global
  local-natural operator mathcal K0 satisfying all evaluations and guards
  nor a local-natural relative-horizontal existence theorem that constructs
  one. Conversely it supplies no theorem proving mathfrak A_K empty on the
  declared reachable scope. Pointwise nonempty smooth fibers, if later
  established, must not be promoted to a global natural section without
  this additional proof.

RESULT_PRECEDENCE:
  This calculation evaluates only the accepted existing corpus against the
  task525 certificate contract. It preserves task519's guard-cut range and
  task514's typed reservoir fiber. It neither adds data nor interprets an
  absent certificate as physical emptiness.

DECLARED_SCOPE_AND_EVIDENCE_UNIT:
  The declared physical domain remains D_7=D_* intersect D_owner. The
  accepted corpus defines this domain and the symbolic objects in I_7(Z),
  but it exhibits no one concrete or symbolic state Z0 together with one
  complete, jointly frozen, evaluable I_7(Z0) packet. The calculation is
  therefore an exact evidence-completeness test, not a numerical scan.

EC0_THROUGH_EC5_EVALUATION:
  EC0 NOT_CERTIFIED_AT_AN_EXHIBITED_STATE:

    every required object to the same evaluated Z0 and accepted source.
  EC1 INPUT_MISSING:

    all output evaluations, is supplied for any Z0.
  EC2 INPUT_MISSING:
    no evaluated complete cap/side/corner chain with all orientations,
    owner weights and inherited w_(p,c)*s_(p,c) is supplied for any Z0.
  EC3 INPUT_MISSING:
    no evaluated pair (g_Z,F_Z) retaining every current, traction, metric,
    acceleration, expansion, embedding, moving-boundary and source term is
    supplied on one common state and chain.
  EC4 INPUT_MISSING:

    truth values and E versus E/T receipts are not evaluated at any Z0.
  EC5 INPUT_MISSING:
    no same-member source-off, null-limit, no-double-count and reachable-
    state receipt is supplied for any Z0.

  is not a violation of any guard.

OUTPUT_CERTIFICATE_EVALUATION:

    satisfying D_Z K_Z=Y_Z on the complete tangent scope and all RG/OR
    guards at one state.
  OE_SUPPORTED: NONE. The corpus supplies no exact incompatible trace, no
    nonzero evaluated obstruction O_a, no proof that a single linear lift
    is impossible and no complete guard-unsatisfiability theorem.
  Therefore the physical truth of R_K_out_R1(Z) nonemptiness or emptiness is
  undecided for every uninstantiated state; failure to exhibit OW is not OE.

RESERVOIR_ALGEBRAIC_PREFILTER:
  For a supplied p and P_rec the exact unguarded rank-2/nullity-3 solution is
    x(alpha,beta,gamma)

        alpha,
        beta,
        P_rec-alpha-beta,

    prefilter. They do not prove disjoint physical channel provenance,
    source-off, owner, kernel/complement, no-double-count, reachability or
    integrated reservoir viability.

RESERVOIR_CERTIFICATE_EVALUATION:

D2SW14_CAPACITY_RESPONSE_SAME_Z_CURVE_CONTRACT_BODY_BEGIN
AUTHOR_INPUT_AND_NOTATION:
  Martin Jambor authorizes capacity_loc as the state-local passive
  differential coefficient of the existing causal traction/current response
  with respect to an invariant dimensionless deformation of the single shared
  contact/Sigma_prep interface. The response may use only existing T_loc,

  The author also authorizes one bounded differentiable same-ontology curve
  Z(s) on the regular domain for an NZ/Z0 certificate. The chat spellings
  Sigma*prep and T*loc are normalized only as Sigma_prep and T_loc; they do not
  create new objects.

PRECEDENCE_AND_SCOPE:
  Accepted task607 and effective task601+task604 remain immutable. Task611 is
  one new certificate-only atom on the same pre-event regular state Z, fixed
  graph incidence, fixed topology, existing material/contact embeddings and
  the same one shared contact/Sigma_prep primitive. Accepted task305 supplies
  Pi_CT, T_CT, traction t_CT and Landau current j_CT. Accepted result312 and
  contract313R1 require traction and current representations to be joined only
  by an explicit common local balance with every geometry/source term; equality
  is not assumed from a shared tensor or from notation. No global K_bridge,
  Xi_Z, A_X, A_K, kernel, I0/PK1 or E_N is introduced or evaluated.

QUESTION_AND_DONE_WHEN:
  Determine whether the author-approved capacity response gives one exact C2
  same-ontology curve Z(s), |s|<epsilon, Z(0)=Z, whose tangent is a certified
  member of T_raw(Z)\V_rel(Z). Apply the effective task604 proof-status order:
    1. both complete Z0 and NZ packets -> MATERIAL_FINDING_INCONSISTENT_Q;
    2. Z0 only -> Z0_CERT;
    3. NZ only -> NZ_CERT_CAPACITY_RESPONSE_CURVE;
    4. neither -> N1_CAPACITY_RESPONSE_CURVE_WAITING, naming the earliest
       missing response, regularity, local-existence or full-constraint datum.
  Failure or passivity exclusion of this one curve is not a universal Z0 proof
  and does not close C01-RW1, P5 or A2-K4.

FIXED_STATE_AND_CURVE_TYPE:
  Choose no new contact or owner. The target is one already existing contact e
  whose shared physical face is the same primitive as Sigma_prep on the fixed
  branch. A candidate curve has only the accepted state entries
    Z(s)=({c_f(s)},{X_a(s)},X_Sigma(s)),
  with Z(0)=Z. T_loc[Z(s)], u_cell[Z(s)], h_cell, n, q, induced measures,
  projectors, T_CT, t_CT and j_CT are all derived. Other capacities or
  embeddings may be constant only if the complete constraints prove that
  choice; they are not set to zero by convention.

INVARIANT_DIMENSIONLESS_DEFORMATION:
  Let
    A_e(s):=integral_(Sigma_e(s)) dA_q(s)
  be the positive finite physical area of the single shared face in the
  induced Landau spatial geometry. On a candidate branch with A_e(0)>0 and
  nonzero first area variation, use the unique local parameter
    s:=ln(A_e/A_e(0)),
  with the sign fixed by physical area increase and s=0 at Z. This uses the
  existing base-state area only as a ratio, not as a new scale. Its material
  generator xi_s:=dX/ds must obey matched-face gluing and the inherited
  pre-event orientation/owner. If area is not smooth, positive, or locally
  usable as a parameter, return the exact WAITING datum; do not clamp, take an
  absolute value or substitute a coordinate displacement.

TWO_EXISTING_RESPONSE_REPRESENTATIONS:
  Along a candidate curve define the facewise traction response by the exact
  accepted oriented work pairing
    R_T,e(s):=w_e sigma_e integral_(Sigma_e(s))
                 T_CT^(mu nu)[Z(s)] xi_s,nu dSigma_mu,
  equivalently with the normal+mixed traction t_CT and the identical face
  weight w_e in {0,1} and inherited orientation sigma_e in {-1,+1}. Count the
  shared face once. No post-integral orientation choice is allowed.

  Independently derive the current-plus-geometry representation R_Jg,e(s)
  from j_CT=rho_L u_cell on the same parent causal worldtube by differentiating
  its oriented cap/side current functional and expanding, before integration,
  every induced-measure, normal, cap/storage, moving-side, metric, embedding,
  Q_CT, stress-power and corner term required by Cartan/Stokes and the accepted
  conservation identity. R_Jg,e is a derivation target, not a new function or
  a free residual. No term may be declared zero merely because it is absent
  from the current corpus.

  A single causal traction/current response R_e(s) exists in this atom only if
  a pointwise curve-local common-balance derivation proves
    R_T,e(s)=R_Jg,e(s)=:R_e(s)
  on an open interval around s=0 with the same face weights, orientation and
  source convention. Defining R_Jg as R_T, defining a residual by subtraction,
  or importing a global K_bridge is forbidden. If the equality cannot be
  derived from existing T_loc and geometry, return
    N1_CAPACITY_RESPONSE_CURVE_WAITING / MISSING_CURVE_LOCAL_COMMON_RESPONSE.

CAPACITY_CONSTITUTIVE_CLOSURE_AND_UNITS:
  On a proved common-response branch define, without absolute value or clamp,
    c_e[Z(s)] := dR_e(s)/ds.
  Because s is dimensionless, c_e has exactly the units of R_e, fixed by T_loc
  and the induced measures; no normalization or fitted energy scale is added.
  This is a constitutive constraint on the existing capacity coordinate, not a
  permission to select c_e. The curve must be regular enough that R_e is C2,
  c_e(s) is C1 and delta c_e=dc_e/ds|0 exists. Local existence of the coupled
  implicit curve must be proved from the existing smooth maps, for example by
  an applicable constant-rank/implicit-function argument with its rank guard;
  it may not be assumed from the definition.

PASSIVITY_AND_RANGE_GUARD:
  With the frozen physical orientation, incremental passivity requires
    c_e[Z(s)]>=0
  on the declared local interval and the base value must agree with the actual
  existing c_e at Z. Equality is allowed. A negative value exactly excludes
  only this oriented curve member. Unknown sign, absent response derivative or
  absent base-value match returns WAITING; no arbitrary finite upper bound is
  introduced. Any later upper bound must be derived from existing geometry,
  conservation and regularity, not from a fit or numerical cutoff.

FULL_CURVE_CONSTRAINT_PACKET_G0_G8:
  G0 regularity: the whole interval remains on the same fixed-active-set,
     fixed-incidence, Type-I, unique nondegenerate smooth Landau branch;
  G1 one-face gluing: X_a(s)|F_e=X_Sigma(s) composed with i_e, with fixed i_e,
     fixed topology/orientation and no double count;
  G2 derived geometry: metric, area form, normal, boundary and worldtube
     variations are exact derivatives of that one physical primitive;
  G3 response closure: the two independently derived representations satisfy
     the curve-local common-balance proof above and the actual capacity obeys
     c_e=dR_e/ds;
  G4 passivity: c_e>=0 with the frozen orientation and no clamp;
  G5 conservation: the complete accepted local T_loc/T_CT source, Noether,
     cap/side/storage, complement and shared-contact ledger holds along the
     curve; no Q, geometry or reservoir term is silently set to zero;
  G6 Landau: the exact eigenproblem, normalization, future orientation,
     nondegeneracy and its differentiated equations hold along the curve;
  G7 gauge: coordinate change, reparametrization and state-preserving relabel
     are the only vertical directions, exactly as in task583/task596;
  G8 differentiability and locality: all maps needed above have the declared
     jets on one neighborhood of Z and use only existing state-local objects.

  The preferred certificate is nonlinear: verify G0-G8 for every s in a local
  interval. Differentiating those identities at s=0 then supplies the complete
  D C_Z(delta Z)=0 packet required by task601 F0-F7. If only first-order
  formulas are available, every component of D C_Z must instead be written
  explicitly; a selected subset is insufficient.

NONVERTICAL_CERTIFICATE:
  For any curve satisfying the full packet, the representation-invariant
  observable along the fixed physical contact is
    I_A(s):=ln(A_e(s)/A_e(0))=s,
    dI_A/ds|0=1.
  Coordinate changes, surface reparametrizations and state-preserving
  relabelings leave physical area unchanged, so this derivative proves
  delta Z notin V_rel. It may be used only after G0-G8 and the actual-state
  capacity match pass; a formal normal deformation alone remains insufficient.

BOUNDED_ANALYTIC_WORK_AFTER_DUAL_CONTRACT_PASS:
  CR1 inventory one actual existing contact e and its base c_e, area, owner,
      regular Landau branch and exact T_loc lineage;
  CR2 derive R_T,e and R_Jg,e independently and test their pointwise
      curve-local common balance without a global K_bridge;
  CR3 solve or fail-closed classify local existence of the coupled C2 curve
      with c_e=dR_e/ds, gluing and all G0-G8 constraints;
  CR4 if a curve exists, verify passivity, base-value match and dI_A/ds=1,
      then emit the full NZ packet; otherwise name the earliest missing or
      violated guard without treating search failure as Z0;
  CR5 apply the effective task604 four-way proof-status order and stop before
      Xi_Z, kernel, I0/PK1, E_N, owner/power/reservoir selection or dynamics.

NONCLAIMS_AND_TRACK_IDENTITY:
  The contract does not assert that the curve, common response, capacity
  derivative or NZ certificate exists. It does not identify beta_J alone with
  physical boundary work, set geometry/source terms to zero, import a global
  bridge, add a surface law, field, state, scale, clock, memory, topology,
  causal rule, owner, reset, reservoir channel or fit. WAITING or exclusion of
  this member leaves the parent track LIVE/WAITING. A need for a new primitive
  or changed ontology triggers Martin's identity decision rather than an
  automatic same-track repair or closure.

D2SW14_TASK611B_TYPED_RESPONSE_DELTA_BODY_BEGIN
PRECEDENCE:
  This delta replaces only task611 INVARIANT_DIMENSIONLESS_DEFORMATION and
  TWO_EXISTING_RESPONSE_REPRESENTATIONS, plus the meanings of xi_s, R_T,e and
  R_Jg,e in their downstream references. All other task611 clauses remain
  effective. In particular, c_e=dR_e/ds, G0-G8, the nonlinear full-constraint
  requirement, the area nonvertical invariant, proof-status order, nonclaims
  and no-Xi/kernel/E_N reach are unchanged.

TYPED_SPATIAL_FACE_AND_DEFORMATION_PARAMETER:
  Let F_e(s) be the two-dimensional physical shared contact section in the
  pre-event Landau spatial slice; it is the single contact/Sigma_prep
  primitive restricted to that slice and is counted once. Its induced area is
    A_e(s):=integral_(F_e(s)) dA_q(s).
  On a branch with A_e(0)>0 and nonzero smooth first area variation set
    s:=ln(A_e(s)/A_e(0)),
  locally with s=0 at Z and sign fixed by physical area increase. Let
    V_e:=dX_Sigma/ds
  be the matched spatial/material face generator. It obeys
  X_a|F_e=X_Sigma composed with i_e and does not itself carry a directed
  spacetime three-surface element. Failure of this parameter guard returns
  exact WAITING with no substitute coordinate displacement.

TYPED_WORLDTUBE_CHAIN_AND_GENERATOR:
  Let Gamma_e be the swept spacetime side face generated by F_e along the
  existing parent causal worldtube, and let C_W[Z(s)] be the complete oriented
  three-chain of contract313R1,
    C_W=Sigma_+-Sigma_-+sum_(p,c) w_(p,c) sigma_(p,c) Gamma_(p,c).
  Every Gamma carries a directed three-surface element dSigma_mu; every cap,
  side and corner uses the same inherited pre-event weight and orientation.
  The full spacetime material generator xi_s is the unique lift of the curve
  tangent dZ/ds when that lift exists. Its restriction to F_e induces V_e.
  Ambiguous lift, owner, orientation or worldtube is WAITING, not a convention.

REPLACEMENT_TRACTION_RESPONSE:
  The energy-valued traction/Noether response conjugate to the local area
  deformation is the already accepted full-chain pairing
    R_T,e(s):=beta_T^CT[Z(s)](dZ/ds)
             =sum_(faces H in C_W[Z(s)])
                integral_H T_CT^(mu nu)[Z(s)] xi_s,nu dSigma_mu,
  with all face signs and weights applied before integration. On the target
  swept side Gamma_e its spatial trace is exactly the normal+mixed traction
  pairing
    w_e sigma_e integral_(F_e(s)) t_CT,mu V_e^mu dA_q,
  together with the moving-side conversion dictated by the spacetime lift.
  This side trace is not substituted for the cap, storage, metric, embedding
  or other side terms of the full chain.

REPLACEMENT_CURRENT_PLUS_GEOMETRY_RESPONSE:
  Independently derive R_Jg,e(s) from the accepted parent-worldtube Landau
  current functional beta_J^CT[Z(s)](dZ/ds), not from a two-surface integral.
  The derivation must expand on the same C_W every cap/storage, moving-side,
  induced-measure, normal, metric, embedding, Q_CT, stress-power and corner
  term required by Cartan/Stokes and local conservation. R_Jg,e has the same
  energy units as R_T,e because s is dimensionless. It remains a derivation
  target and may not be defined as R_T,e or by their post-integral residual.

COMMON_RESPONSE_GUARD:
  A scalar R_e(s) exists only after a pointwise curve-local common-balance
  proof establishes
    R_T,e(s)=R_Jg,e(s)=:R_e(s)
  on one open interval around s=0 with the identical full chain, generator,
  source convention, face weights and orientations. The proof may be local to
  this one curve and is not a global K_bridge. If it is absent, return
    N1_CAPACITY_RESPONSE_CURVE_WAITING / MISSING_TYPED_CURVE_LOCAL_COMMON_RESPONSE.

DEPENDENT_NOTATION_REPLACEMENT:
  In every unchanged task611 clause, xi_s now means the typed full spacetime
  lift above, the area invariant uses F_e and dA_q, and all response integrals
  use C_W/Gamma faces with dSigma_mu. No integral may mix these form degrees.
D2SW14_TASK611B_TYPED_RESPONSE_DELTA_BODY_END

D2SW10_PK1_CAPACITY_TRANSPORT_KERNEL_DICHOTOMY_BODY_BEGIN
PRECEDENCE_AND_SCOPE:
  Accepted task552 and its task553/task554 dual PASS remain the immediate
  scientific input. Task557 supersedes only task556's waiting-only next
  action. It tests the highest-ranked PK1 package on the already accepted
  fixed-incidence regular Z_rec=[B_rec,Sigma_prep]_rel state. It neither
  changes PK1 nor selects PK2.

FROZEN_EXISTING_DEFINITIONS:
  Contract295 defines
    B_rec=[G_loc,capacity_loc,geometry_loc]_rel,
    Sigma_prep=[S_prep,q_ab,n^mu,boundary(S_prep)]_rel.
  The _rel quotient removes relabels, allowed coordinate changes and
  representation changes preserving incidence, capacity and physical
  geometry. It does not quotient physically distinct capacity, geometry,
  connectivity or prepared-interface states. Task547 defines
    I0 TRANSPORT_COMPLETE:
      ker(Xi_Z) contains only relabel directions and the material generator
      spans the physical quotient tangent.
  Task552 fixes on Q_Z=T_Z/G_rel
    X_Z=Xi_Z|Q_Z,
    Y_Z=(g_Z,F_Z,corner_Z)|Q_Z,
    L_N,Z=D_Z compose N_T,Z,
    E_N=Y_Z-L_N,Z X_Z.

CAPACITY_AND_GEOMETRY_TANGENT_SPLIT_TO_BE_PROVED_NOT_ASSUMED:
  On one existing fixed-incidence regular stratum define only as test sets
    V_cap(Z):={deltaZ in Q_Z:
      delta geometry_loc=0, delta Sigma_prep=0,
      delta capacity_loc may be nonzero},
    V_geom(Z):={deltaZ in Q_Z:
      delta capacity_loc=0,
      geometry_loc or Sigma_prep may vary}.
  Membership requires exact existing lineage and a proof that the direction
  is physical rather than relabel. The contract does not assert that either
  set is nonzero, independent, complementary or complete.

PK1_CAPACITY_KERNEL_THEOREM_OBLIGATION:
  Define
    K_cap(Z):=V_cap(Z) intersect ker(X_Z).
  The following implications are exact:
    KT-A if one nonzero physical deltaZ_cap lies in K_cap(Z), then
      ker(X_Z) is nonzero and PK1/I0 is
      EXCLUDED_EXACT_DECLARED_SCOPE at that Z;
    KT-B if every physical capacity direction is mapped injectively by X_Z,
      that fact must follow from an existing unique quotient-covariant
      capacity-to-material-generator law. Absence of the law is WAITING,
      never an assumption of injectivity;
    KT-C if V_cap(Z) is proved zero because capacity is fixed or uniquely
      constrained by existing geometry on the declared stratum, the proof
      must provide the exact constraint and tangent derivative. A chosen
      fixed-capacity slice is not such a proof;
    KT-D only after a proved-complete Q_Z and ker(X_Z)=0 may the calculation
      evaluate E_N. E_N cannot repair a failed I0 kernel gate.

EXACT_EQUIVALENT_SCOPED_THEOREM_ROUTE:
  A capacity/geometry theorem is sufficient for task556 C1-C2 only if it
  proves on one declared existing regular subdomain all of:
    T0 the finite/fiberwise state alphabet and quotient tangent are complete;
    T1 every capacity and geometry direction has existing provenance;
    T2 the material-generator map is single-valued, linear and
       quotient-covariant on the whole Q_Z;
    T3 either a nonzero kernel witness is exhibited or injectivity is proved;
    T4 no physical capacity direction is discarded by a coordinate,
       identifier, fixed-slice or post-hoc convention.
  This theorem does not supply owner, active power or reservoir gates.

BOUNDED_ANALYTIC_CALCULATION_AFTER_DUAL_CONTRACT_PASS:
  KT1 read the accepted state alphabet and enumerate only explicitly present
      capacity and geometry tangent families without inventing dimensions;
  KT2 decide whether contract295 or a hash-bound accepted descendant gives
      an exact capacity-to-material-generator law;
  KT3 apply KT-A through KT-D and T0 through T4 exhaustively;
  KT4 if a nonzero K_cap witness is proved, exclude PK1 only on that exact
      scope; otherwise return the exact missing law or completeness proof;
  KT5 if and only if injectivity is proved, continue to the fixed residual
      E_N on the same complete basis;
  KT6 preserve the ordered PK2-PK10 states and identify one next exact
      discriminator. Perform the calculation analytically without Python,
      network access or an official run.

DECISION_BRANCHES:
  PK1_EXCLUDED_CAPACITY_KERNEL_EXACT_SCOPE:
    one nonzero physical capacity direction is in ker(X_Z).
  PK1_I0_INJECTIVE_SCOPE_CONTINUE_TO_FIXED_RESIDUAL:
    T0-T4 and ker(X_Z)=0 are proved on a declared existing scope.
  PK1_CAPACITY_TRANSPORT_LAW_OR_COMPLETENESS_WAITING:
    current evidence cannot prove either branch; parent and PK1 remain
    LIVE/WAITING with the exact missing input recorded.
  MATERIAL_FINDING:
    classify P0/T1/S1-S4 and return to the earliest valid point.

NONCLAIMS:
  A physical capacity variation is not assumed to have zero generator; a
  fixed-capacity slice is not selected; no dimension, rank, null direction,
  stress response, owner, reservoir split, coefficient, scale, rate or
  observable is invented. Contract freeze is not PASS, exclusion, witness,
  packet completion, checkpoint or run authorization. Failure to prove the
  dichotomy cannot close C01-RW1, P5 or A2-K4.
D2SW10_PK1_CAPACITY_TRANSPORT_KERNEL_DICHOTOMY_BODY_END

LANDAU_REDERIVATION_AND_ALLOWED_RANGE:

  mixed tensor is Hawking-Ellis Type I, the above subluminal root is unique,
  its timelike eigenvalue is simple and distinct from every spacelike
  eigenvalue, the future orientation is fixed, and the branch is smooth.
  For q!=0 the analytic planar prefilter requires
    (E+P_n)^2-4*q^2>0

  u_cell may equal u_plasma only as a derived accidental equality after the

        G_res channel provenance on the same frozen member.
  Q1R6 supplies neither owner nor reset. No owner/reset may be inferred from

AUTHOR_INPUT: Martin-Jambor-approved-D2SW7-bounded-state-local-feasibility-over-existing-regular-domain_existing-fields_geometry_sources-and-guards_only_to-prove-or-refute-guarded-output-nonemptiness-and-find-one-guarded-reservoir-witness_without-global-Kbridge_new-field_or-fitted-scale

D2SW7_CONTRACT_BODY_BEGIN
CONTRACT_PRECEDENCE:
  This contract preserves accepted task514 typing and task519 corrected
  guard-cut result. It does not modify OR-C01-RW1-KOUT-001 and does not
  resolve UF-C01-RW1-KBRIDGE-001. Task512 and the affected affine-closure
  reach of task517 remain quarantined. Accepted task519 is the exact input
  set definition; D2SW7 adds only witness/refutation certificate rules.

BOUNDED_PHYSICAL_SCOPE:
  D_7 := D_* intersect D_owner.
  Here D_* is the already accepted regular Type-I Landau domain with a
  unique future-directed one-dimensional nondegenerate timelike eigenspace,
  smooth single-valued T_loc[Z], fixed incidence/topology, regular geometry
  and the accepted causal parent worldtube. D_owner adds the unique binary
  pre-event causal owner. No extension, clamp, fallback frame, new state,
  field, topology, causal edge, memory or fitted scale is permitted.

STATE_LOCAL_EVALUATION_PACKET:
  For each fixed Z in D_7 define I_7(Z) only as a provenance bundle of
  already existing quantities:
    T_Z, L_Z, W_pc[Z], complete oriented face/corner chain C_W[Z],
    g_Z:T_Z->Omega3(boundary W_pc[Z]),
    F_Z:T_Z->Omega4(W_pc[Z]), D_Z, Y_Z=(g_Z,F_Z), D_uZ,
    G_outer(Z), G_phys(Z)=OR1-OR8R1, P_rec(Z), and G_res(Z).
  I_7 is not a physical field or enlarged state. It is evaluable only when:
    EC0 every listed object has exact lineage to accepted existing fields;
    EC1 the full tangent map is given invariantly or on one proved-complete
        basis of T_Z, never by unrelated per-direction choices;
    EC2 all caps, sides, corners, orientations, owner weights and inherited
        w_(p,c)*s_(p,c) are complete and mutually consistent;
    EC3 g_Z and F_Z retain every current, traction, metric, acceleration,
        expansion, embedding, moving-boundary and source term;
    EC4 every equality/inequality predicate in G_outer, G_phys and G_res is
        exactly evaluable with units E or E/T as applicable;
    EC5 source-off, null-limit, no-double-count and reachable-state checks
        are evaluable on the same member and same frozen Z.
  Failure of EC0-EC5 is INPUT_SCOPE_INCOMPLETE, not evidence that any
  physical allowed set is empty.

OUTPUT_FEASIBILITY_PROBLEM:
  Use the accepted task519 definitions
    R_geom_lin(Z)={K_Z in L_Z:D_Z K_Z=Y_Z},
    R_K_out_R1(Z)=R_geom_lin(Z) intersect G_outer(Z) intersect G_phys(Z).
  The calculation must decide only by one of the following certificates.

OUTPUT_WITNESS_CERTIFICATE OW(Z,K_Z):
  OW is valid iff one explicit linear map K_Z in L_Z, built only from the
  allowed existing full jet, satisfies simultaneously:
    OW0 EC0-EC5 for the same Z;
    OW1 D_Z K_Z=Y_Z for every allowed deltaZ, including complete face and
        bulk equalities with compatible corner pullbacks;
    OW2 RG1-RG4, including a single linear lift rather than per-direction
        representatives;
    OW3 every predicate of G_outer and OR1-OR8R1 on that same K_Z;
    OW4 the same-member complete oriented Stokes derivation gives
        p_g(Z)=<g_Z[D_uZ],C_W[Z]>=S_in^CT with units E/T;
    OW5 covariance, quotient/relabel, combined full-jet kernel, causal
        owner, conservation, stability, regularity, source-off, null-limit
        and no-double-count receipts are explicit and fail closed.
  OW proves R_K_out_R1(Z) nonempty at this Z. K_Z is only an existence
  witness; it is not selected as a unique law, global section or preferred
  representative, and the scientific output remains the entire guard-cut
  set R_K_out_R1(Z).

OUTPUT_EMPTY_CERTIFICATE OE(Z):
  OE is valid only by an exact proof of at least one of:
    OE1 incompatible face/corner trace data in RG1;
    OE2 violation of the differential-complex compatibility in RG2;
    OE3 an explicit component a and tangent deltaZ with
        O_a[Z;deltaZ]=integral_(W_a)F_Z[deltaZ]
                       -integral_(boundary W_a)g_Z[deltaZ] != 0;
    OE4 proof that no single linear lift can satisfy RG4;
    OE5 a complete logical/analytic unsatisfiability certificate showing
        every K_Z in R_geom_lin(Z) violates G_outer or G_phys.
  Failure to construct a witness, a finite ansatz scan, a missing basis,
  unevaluated guard or numerical search with zero hits is not OE.
  OE proves only R_K_out_R1(Z)=empty at the certified state/subscope.

BOUNDARY_POWER_AFTER_OUTPUT_CERTIFICATE:
  Only OW permits the state-local boundary-power result
    R_P_out_R1(Z)={p_g(Z)}.
  OE gives R_P_out_R1(Z)=empty at that certified Z. INPUT_SCOPE_INCOMPLETE
  leaves the set undecided. No finite interval, zero, midpoint, minimum norm
  or chosen K_Z may replace this three-way logic.

RESERVOIR_FEASIBILITY_PROBLEM:
  Only after OW at the same Z set p=p_g(Z) and use
    x=(D_uE_res,P_store,P_diss,P_RW1export,L_ext)^T,
    A=[[1,1,1,1,1],[0,1,1,1,0]],
    b=(p_g(Z),P_rec(Z))^T,
    S_aff={x0+alpha*v_alpha+beta*v_beta+gamma*v_gamma},
  with the accepted x0,v_alpha,v_beta,v_gamma of task514. Define
    A_res[Z;p_g,P_rec]=S_aff[Z;p_g,P_rec] intersect G_res(Z).

RESERVOIR_WITNESS_CERTIFICATE RW(Z,x):
  RW is valid iff one explicit x, equivalently explicit real
  alpha,beta,gamma, satisfies Ax=b exactly and every frozen reservoir
  sign, storage, dissipation, export, external-loss, source-off,
  no-double-count, binary-owner, kernel/complement and reachable-state
  guard with complete channel provenance. RW proves A_res nonempty but does
  not select x or its null direction as a law; the accepted result remains
  the complete guarded fiber.

RESERVOIR_EMPTY_CERTIFICATE RE(Z):
  RE is valid only by an exact contradiction between Ax=b and G_res over
  the entire affine fiber, or another complete analytic unsatisfiability
  proof. Rank(A)=2, nullity(A)=3, failure of x0, failure of finitely many
  alpha,beta,gamma trials or unevaluated guards cannot prove RE.
  RE excludes only the declared state/subscope and does not imply output
  emptiness or closure of the parent track.

SCOPE_COVERAGE_AND_SET_OUTPUT:
  The result must return the certified subsets
    D_OW={Z in D_7: an OW certificate is exhibited},
    D_OE={Z in D_7: an OE certificate is exhibited},
    D_RW={Z in D_OW: an RW certificate is exhibited},
    D_RE={Z in D_OW: an RE certificate is exhibited},
    D_U =D_7 minus (D_OW union D_OE),
  with overlap checks D_OW intersect D_OE=empty and
  D_RW intersect D_RE=empty. No claim that these sets cover D_7 is allowed
  unless exact coverage is proved. States with incomplete I_7 remain in
  D_U and are LIVE/WAITING.

DECISION_BRANCHES:
  COUPLED_OUTPUT_RESERVOIR_RANGE_PASS_STATE_LOCAL:
    at least one explicit Z0,K_Z0,x0 has accepted OW and RW certificates;
    accept R_K_out_R1(Z0) nonempty, R_P_out_R1(Z0)={p_g(Z0)} and the entire
    A_res[Z0;p_g,P_rec], without global Kbridge inference.
  OUTPUT_RANGE_EXISTENCE_PASS_STATE_LOCAL_ONLY:
    at least one OW exists but no RW or RE is yet certified at that state;
    output existence passes locally and reservoir remains conditional.
  OUTPUT_RELAXATION_EMPTY_FOR_CERTIFIED_STATE_OR_SUBSCOPE:
    one or more OE certificates exist; exclude only their exact scope.
  RESERVOIR_PREIMAGE_EMPTY_FOR_CERTIFIED_STATE_OR_SUBSCOPE:
    one or more RE certificates exist after OW; exclude only their exact
    reservoir intersection.
  COMPLETE_D7_EMPTY_SCOPE_CERTIFIED:
    allowed only if exact coverage proves D_OE=D_7; this would trigger the
    S1-S4 finding/identity process and Martin decision, not automatic parent
    closure.
  INPUT_SCOPE_INCOMPLETE_LIVE_WAITING:
    no admissible certificate decides the requested scope because EC0-EC5
    or exact coverage is missing; document only the exact missing existing
    inputs, with no conditional-only successor churn.
  INVALID_CONTRACT_OR_MATERIAL_FINDING:
    classify P0/T1/S1-S4 and return to the earliest valid point.

DONE_WHEN_FOR_BOUNDED_ANALYTIC_RESULT:
  Evaluate the accepted existing corpus against EC0-EC5 and return every
  actually supported OW/OE/RW/RE certificate and certified subset. A PASS
  requires an explicit witness or theorem, an empty result requires an exact
  unsatisfiability certificate, and missing evaluation remains LIVE/WAITING.

D2SW7_NONCLAIMS:
  No global or local-natural K_bridge, smooth/measurable selection, unique
  K_Z, selected reservoir vector or null direction, new field, new scale,
  new surface law, dynamics, observable prediction or theory-wide
  feasibility is created. D2I, D3-D6, P5.4, G8, G9 and A3 remain closed.
  A state-local OE/RE does not close C01-RW1, P5 or A2-K4.
D2SW7_CONTRACT_BODY_END

PRECEDENCE_AND_FROZEN_SCOPE:
  D_SV=D_star_intersect_D_owner on the regular Type-I nondegenerate smooth
  T_loc domain with the unique future-directed Landau u_cell and the
  pre-event oriented parent causal worldtube C_W. Contracts295R1,297,313R1,
  accepted result314R1 and accepted task506 remain immutable inputs.
  Task512 does not unquarantine task504 and does not replace or close
  UF-C01-RW1-KBRIDGE-001. It replaces only the next bounded computational
  interface: one global Kbridge witness is no longer selected or presumed.

FROZEN_TYPES:
  For each Z in D_SV,
    T_Z := T_Z(D_SV),
    V_Z := Omega^3(W_pc[Z]),
    L_Z := Hom_R(T_Z,V_Z).
  A member K_Z of L_Z is a complete state-local linear output map
    deltaZ -> K_Z[deltaZ].
  Its oriented face integral is energy-valued and evaluation on D_uZ has
  power units E/T. A single three-form at one deltaZ is not by itself a
  field-space one-form and cannot be promoted to one.

EXACT_REALIZABLE_IMAGE:
  Let mathfrak A_K be the accepted task506 global local-natural operator
  allowed set. Define
    R_K_exact(Z)
      := {ev_Z(mathcal K): mathcal K in mathfrak A_K},
  where ev_Z(mathcal K) is the entire linear map
    deltaZ -> mathcal K[Z;deltaZ] in L_Z.
  Nonemptiness and emptiness of R_K_exact remain undecided exactly because
  nonemptiness and emptiness of mathfrak A_K remain undecided.

STATE_LOCAL_OUTER_OUTPUT_RANGE:
  Using the accepted task506 pointwise geometric fibers A_geom(Z,deltaZ),
  define
    R_K_outer(Z)
      := {K_Z in L_Z:
          for every deltaZ in T_Z,
          K_Z[deltaZ] in A_geom(Z,deltaZ),
          K_Z uses only the frozen allowed full-jet values at Z,
          the cap, side, corner and bulk target typings are preserved,
          and no field, scale, topology, causal rule, memory or fitted
          representative is introduced}.
  This is a state-local output range. It does not require or construct a
  smooth, measurable or local-natural selection Z -> K_Z.

PHYSICALLY_GUARDED_OUTPUT_RANGE:
  Define R_K_out(Z) as the subset of R_K_outer(Z) whose complete linear map
  also satisfies, for every allowed deltaZ at the same Z:
    OR1 pure-relabel zero or exact internal pure transport with zero net
        assigned RW1 work;
    OR2 combined full-jet KERNEL_COMPAT_CT without choosing beta_corr;
    OR3 quotient G_K(Pi_CT) and the same P_E+P_nn+P_mix traction sector;
    OR4 exact future orientation, unique binary owner, causal worldtube and
        identical facewise w_(p,c)*s_(p,c) in all ledgers;
    OR5 exact cap/storage/inertial current trace including measure and
        embedding terms;
    OR6 exact normal+mixed side traction trace including every moving-side,
        metric and embedding term;
    OR7 exact dK bulk density with all existing Q_CT,current,metric,geometry,
        acceleration,expansion and source terms and one complete-chain
        Stokes identity;
    OR8 source-off, regularity, conservation, causality, stability, units,
        null-limit, no-double-count and reservoir guards fail closed.
  No term may be dropped by convention and no post-integral betaT-betaJ
  residual may be used to manufacture a member.

REQUIRED_INCLUSION_AND_NONCONVERSE:
  Every global physical operator has a physically guarded state-local value,
  hence
    R_K_exact(Z) subseteq R_K_out(Z) subseteq R_K_outer(Z).
  Task512 does not assert either converse. A member of R_K_out at one state
  does not prove one global local-natural Kbridge, cross-state coherence,
  a smooth/measurable selection or well-posed dynamics.

SET_VALUED_BOUNDARY_POWER_IMAGE:
  For K_Z in R_K_out(Z), define only after its OR1-OR8 proof
    beta_(K_Z)[Z](deltaZ)
      := <K_Z[deltaZ],C_W[Z]>,
    p_(K_Z)(Z):=beta_(K_Z)[Z](D_uZ).
  The allowed output-power correspondence is
    R_P_out(Z)
      := {p_(K_Z)(Z): K_Z in R_K_out(Z)
          and the same member's face/bulk Stokes identity derives the frozen
          incoming-source equality p_(K_Z)=S_in^CT}.
  Membership is not inferred from the scalar equality alone. No midpoint,
  minimum-norm value, zero value, null direction or finite numeric interval
  is selected. Without an existing physical bound the result remains a
  general set, not an invented closed interval.

RESERVOIR_SET_PROPAGATION:
  For every p in R_P_out(Z), retain the full rank-2/nullity-3 fiber
    A_res[Z;p,P_rec]
      ={x0(p,P_rec)+alpha*v_alpha+beta*v_beta+gamma*v_gamma:
        all frozen guards hold},
    x0(p,P_rec)=(p-P_rec,0,0,P_rec,0)^T,
    v_alpha=(0,1,0,-1,0)^T,
    v_beta=(0,0,1,-1,0)^T,
    v_gamma=(-1,0,0,0,1)^T.
  The D2SW6 downstream object is the entire union
    R_res_out(Z)=union_(p in R_P_out(Z)) A_res[Z;p,P_rec].
  Algebraic nonemptiness of A_res for a supplied real p does not prove
  nonemptiness of R_P_out or physical RW1 output existence.

BOUNDED_ANALYTIC_QUESTIONS_AFTER_STATIC_PASS:
  OQ1 determine the exact state-local obstruction for R_K_outer and R_K_out;
  OQ2 determine whether current frozen data prove one explicit member or an
      existence theorem for R_K_out at the declared state-local scope;
  OQ3 compute the exact inclusion and the full set-valued R_P_out and
      R_res_out propagation without selecting a member;
  OQ4 state separately what remains required for R_K_exact realizability,
      cross-state coherence, dynamics and observables.

DECISION_BRANCHES_FOR_TASK514:
  OUTPUT_RANGE_EXISTENCE_PASS_STATE_LOCAL = one explicit K_Z output map or a
      valid state-local existence theorem proves R_K_out nonempty in the
      declared scope; this does not close UF-C01-RW1-KBRIDGE-001;
  OUTPUT_RANGE_CONDITIONAL_OPEN = exact output constraints and obstruction
      are characterized but R_K_out nonemptiness remains undecided;
  OUTPUT_RELAXATION_EMPTY_SCOPE_CERTIFIED = an exact contradiction proves
      R_K_out empty on the declared reachable scope; requires classified
      independent math and physics audits before any track decision;
  INVALID_CONTRACT_OR_FINDING = classify P0/T1/S1-S4 and return to the
      earliest valid point.

TRACK_AND_CLAIM_REACH:
  D2SW6 is a bounded feasibility relaxation inside the author-approved E3
  same-track branch. It is not the final RW1 mechanism. A nonempty R_K_out
  preserves a candidate output range but does not by itself authorize D2I,
  D3-D6, P5.4, G8, G9, observable testing or A3. An empty or undecided
  output range does not close the parent track without the required physical
  finding classification and Martin decision. GLOBAL_FEASIBILITY_INCOMPLETE
  and OBSERVATIONAL_INTERSECTION_NOT_YET_EVALUATED remain mandatory.

QUESTION: characterize-the-full-allowed-Kbridge-set_and-decide-whether-current-accepted-corpus-proves-it-nonempty_without-selecting-one-function

FIXED_STATE_SETUP:
  For each allowed Z in D_SV and each allowed variation deltaZ, write the
  causal worldtube as the disjoint union of connected oriented components
  W_pc = union_a W_a. Let
    g_Z[deltaZ] in Omega^3(boundary W_pc)
  denote the complete oriented face target assembled from the cap/current
  and side/traction expressions with all measure, moving-boundary, metric,
  embedding, owner and orientation factors. Let
    F_Z[deltaZ] in Omega^4(W_pc)
  denote the complete bulk Q_CT/current/metric/geometry/source target. Both
  are field-space linear and energy-valued after integration.

GEOMETRIC_EXTENSION_EQUATIONS:
  Find K in Omega^3(W_pc) such that
    i_boundary^* K = g_Z,
    d K = F_Z.
  In the mapping-cone relative complex the prescribed pair is
    B_Z=(F_Z,g_Z) in Omega^4(W_pc,boundary W_pc),
  and a solution is exactly a relative primitive
    B_Z = D_rel(K,0).

COMPONENTWISE_RELATIVE_STOKES_OBSTRUCTION:
  Before the integral test, the separately derived face expressions must
  assemble to one smooth or piecewise-smooth complete-chain boundary form
  with every induced corner term accounted for. Conditional on that trace
  compatibility, define for every connected component W_a
    O_a[Z;deltaZ]
      = integral_(W_a) F_Z[deltaZ]
        - integral_(boundary W_a) g_Z[deltaZ].
  For a compact oriented four-dimensional worldtube component, a smooth
  geometric solution exists iff O_a[Z;deltaZ]=0 for every a and every
  allowed deltaZ. This is the top-degree relative cohomology obstruction;
  necessity is Stokes and sufficiency follows by extending g into a collar
  and solving the remaining relative top-form with zero component integral.

FULL_SMOOTH_GEOMETRIC_ALLOWED_SET:
  If any trace compatibility condition or any O_a is nonzero,
    A_geom(Z)=empty.
  If all vanish and K0 is one smooth solution,
    A_geom(Z)
      = K0 + Z_rel^3(W_pc),
    Z_rel^3(W_pc)
      ={eta in Omega^3(W_pc): i_boundary^*eta=0 and d eta=0}.
  Modulo relative-exact homogeneous shifts, the remaining topological
  freedom is an affine torsor over H^3(W_pc,boundary W_pc). No class or
  representative is selected.

LOCAL_NATURAL_STATE_FUNCTIONAL_SUBSET:
  The physical set required by RW1 is strictly smaller:
    A_Kbridge(Z)
      = A_geom(Z)
        intersect NatLoc(J_allowed)
        intersect Ker(pure-relabel)
        intersect Ker(KERNEL_COMPAT_CT)
        intersect G_K(Pi_CT)
        intersect all AK7 guards.
  Here NatLoc(J_allowed) contains only covariant natural differential
  operators of the frozen finite jet. Its existence requires the relative
  class B_Z to vanish inside the local-natural/horizontal subcomplex, not
  merely in ordinary smooth de-Rham cohomology. If a local solution K0_loc
  exists, the complete physical freedom is
    K0_loc + {eta_loc in NatLoc(J_allowed):
                i_boundary^*eta_loc=0,
                d_H eta_loc=0,
                pure-relabel_and_combined-kernel_guards_hold}.
  betaCorr is then derived from K0_loc+eta_loc and is never independently
  adjustable.

CURRENT_CORPUS_EVALUATION:
  result314R1 supplies a natural cap/current expression and a natural
  traction side/bulk expression, but no accepted pointwise identity that
  assembles their complete traces and full geometry/source bulk terms into
  one local-natural pair B_Z. Therefore neither all O_a nor the stronger
  local-horizontal obstruction can be evaluated as identically zero or
  nonzero on the reachable D_SV scope. Ordinary smooth extension cannot be
  promoted to a state-sufficient RW1 bridge.

SET_VALUED_DOWNSTREAM_RANGE:
  For any nonempty accepted A_Kbridge(Z), define without selection
    A_Pboundary(Z)
      ={ beta_K(D_u Z): K in A_Kbridge(Z) }.
  The reservoir allowed set is then the union of full conditional fibers
    A_res_set(Z)
      = union_(p in A_Pboundary(Z))
          {x0(p,P_rec)+alpha*v_alpha+beta*v_beta+gamma*v_gamma:
           all frozen guards hold},
  with
    x0(p,P_rec)=(p-P_rec,0,0,P_rec,0)^T,
    v_alpha=(0,1,0,-1,0)^T,
    v_beta=(0,0,1,-1,0)^T,
    v_gamma=(-1,0,0,0,1)^T.
  The rank-2/nullity-3 fiber result is preserved. This union selects no K,
  p, alpha, beta, gamma or null direction.

THEORY_WIDE_AND_MEASUREMENT_STATUS:
  D2SW5 has produced one exact conditional factor for the future common
  feasibility intersection. P5.4/G8/G9 do not yet provide the required
  shared observable map, dataset covariance/systematics or frozen
  confidence region. Consequently
    GLOBAL_FEASIBILITY_INCOMPLETE,
    OBSERVATIONAL_INTERSECTION_NOT_YET_EVALUATED.
  Exact conservation, covariance, causality, gauge/relabel and regularity
  constraints remain zero-tolerance filters inside A_Kbridge. No statement
  that the whole theory already has a common observationally allowed point
  is made.

      preserves covariance, conservation, gauge/relabel, causality,

      neither weakens nor adds a physical law.
  PHILOSOPHICAL_COMPATIBILITY: the correction preserves the same cellular
      ontology, parent causal worldtube, existing stress-energy/current,
      binary owner and no-ad-hoc-data-rescue rule. It separates two existing

  UF-C01-RW1-KBRIDGE-001 remains unresolved and OR-C01-RW1-KOUT-001 remains
  the output correspondence identifier.

CORRECTED_OUTPUT_GUARD_OR8R1:
  OR8R1 applies only bridge/output predicates to K_Z:
    source-off, regularity, conservation, causality, stability, units,
    null-limit and bridge/output no-double-count guards fail closed.
  No reservoir-state sign, storage, dissipation, export, external-loss or
  affine-fiber predicate is a property of K_Z.

CORRECTED_PHYSICALLY_GUARDED_OUTPUT_RANGE:
  Let R_K_out_R1(Z) be the subset of R_K_outer(Z) satisfying OR1-OR7 and
  OR8R1 for every allowed deltaZ at the same Z. Because every accepted
  mathcal K in mathfrak A_K satisfies exactly these bridge/output guards,
    R_K_exact(Z) subseteq R_K_out_R1(Z) subseteq R_K_outer(Z).
  No converse, nonemptiness, smooth selection or global operator existence
  is asserted.

CORRECTED_BOUNDARY_POWER_IMAGE:
  For K_Z in R_K_out_R1(Z), after the same member's OR1-OR8R1 proof define
    beta_(K_Z)[Z](deltaZ)=<K_Z[deltaZ],C_W[Z]>,
    p_(K_Z)(Z)=beta_(K_Z)[Z](D_uZ),
  and
    R_P_out_R1(Z)
      ={p_(K_Z)(Z): K_Z in R_K_out_R1(Z)
        and that member's complete face/bulk Stokes identity derives
        p_(K_Z)=S_in^CT from the frozen pre-event orientation}.
  Scalar equality alone is insufficient. No p, zero, midpoint, finite
  interval, minimum norm, K_Z representative or null direction is selected.

TYPED_RESERVOIR_FIBER_AND_PREIMAGE:
  For each supplied p in R and frozen P_rec, define on reservoir variables
    A_res[Z;p,P_rec]
      ={x0(p,P_rec)+alpha*v_alpha+beta*v_beta+gamma*v_gamma:
        all frozen reservoir-state sign, storage, dissipation, export,
        external-loss, source-off, no-double-count and reachable-state
        guards on x hold},
    x0(p,P_rec)=(p-P_rec,0,0,P_rec,0)^T,
    v_alpha=(0,1,0,-1,0)^T,
    v_beta=(0,0,1,-1,0)^T,
    v_gamma=(-1,0,0,0,1)^T.
  The correctly typed reservoir-feasible boundary-power preimage is
    R_P_res_R1(Z)
      :={p in R_P_out_R1(Z): there exists x in A_res[Z;p,P_rec]}.
  The complete coupled output is
    R_res_out_R1(Z)
      := union_(p in R_P_res_R1(Z)) A_res[Z;p,P_rec]
       = union_(p in R_P_out_R1(Z)) A_res[Z;p,P_rec],
  where empty fibers contribute nothing. Reservoir feasibility filters p
  only through this existential preimage; it never modifies the definition
  of R_K_out_R1 or the exact-image inclusion.

CORRECTED_EXISTENCE_LOGIC:
  rank(A)=2 and nullity(A)=3 remain exact for every supplied real
  b=(p,P_rec). Algebraic nonemptiness of the unguarded affine solution fiber
  for a supplied p does not prove R_K_out_R1, R_P_out_R1 or R_P_res_R1
  nonempty. Conversely an empty reservoir fiber at one p excludes only that
  p from R_P_res_R1 and does not prove R_K_out_R1 empty.

  OUTPUT_RANGE_EXISTENCE_PASS_STATE_LOCAL = one explicit K_Z output map or

FIXED_STATE_LINEAR_CONSTRAINT_OPERATOR:
  Fix Z in D_SV and write
    T_Z=T_Z(D_SV),
    V_Z=Omega^3(W_pc[Z]),
    L_Z=Hom_R(T_Z,V_Z).
  Let the frozen complete boundary and bulk targets be the linear map
    Y_Z:T_Z -> Omega^3(boundary W_pc[Z]) direct-sum Omega^4(W_pc[Z]),
    Y_Z(deltaZ)=(g_Z[deltaZ],F_Z[deltaZ]).
  Define the linear trace-derivative operator on state-local output maps
    D_Z:L_Z -> Hom_R(T_Z,
                     Omega^3(boundary W_pc[Z]) direct-sum
                     Omega^4(W_pc[Z])),
    (D_Z K_Z)(deltaZ)
      =(i_boundary^*K_Z[deltaZ],dK_Z[deltaZ]).
  Therefore the geometric part of the outer output range is exactly the
  linear inverse image
    R_geom_lin(Z)={K_Z in L_Z:D_Z K_Z=Y_Z}.

STATE_LOCAL_GEOMETRIC_OBSTRUCTION:
  For every connected worldtube component W_a[Z] and every deltaZ define
    O_a[Z;deltaZ]
      =integral_(W_a[Z]) F_Z[deltaZ]
       -integral_(boundary W_a[Z]) g_Z[deltaZ].
  A member of R_geom_lin requires simultaneously:
    RG1 all face/corner pullbacks of g_Z are compatible on the complete
        oriented chain with the inherited w_(p,c)*s_(p,c);
    RG2 dF_Z[deltaZ]=0 where the differential-complex identity applies and
        d_boundary g_Z[deltaZ]=i_boundary^*F_Z[deltaZ];
    RG3 O_a[Z;deltaZ]=0 for every component a and every deltaZ;
    RG4 the resulting smooth geometric solutions admit one linear lift
        deltaZ -> K_Z[deltaZ] using only the frozen allowed full-jet values.
  RG1-RG3 are the accepted relative top-degree obstruction tests. RG4 keeps
  the state-local field-space one-form typing and prevents independent
  per-direction choices from being called one K_Z.

CONDITIONAL_AFFINE_OUTPUT_RANGE:
  If one state-local geometric lift K_Z0 satisfying RG1-RG4 exists, then
    R_K_outer(Z)=K_Z0+Z_outer(Z),
  where
    Z_outer(Z)
      ={H_Z in L_Z:
        for every deltaZ,
        i_boundary^*H_Z[deltaZ]=0,
        dH_Z[deltaZ]=0,
        and all frozen no-new-content/output-typing guards hold}.
  After intersecting with OR1-OR8R1, if one physical state-local member
  K_Zphys exists, the full allowed output range is
    R_K_out_R1(Z)=K_Zphys+Z_phys(Z),
  where Z_phys is the homogeneous subset also preserving pure relabel,
  combined full-jet kernel, quotient, traction-sector, owner, causality,
  source, regularity, stability, units, null-limit and bridge/output
  no-double-count guards. This is the complete conditional range; no member
  or cohomology representative is selected.

EXACT_IMAGE_RELATION:
  Accepted task514 gives at every Z
    R_K_exact(Z) subseteq R_K_out_R1(Z) subseteq R_K_outer(Z).
  The first set is the image of one global local-natural operator space; the
  second drops cross-state natural-section existence but preserves every
  fixed-state physical output guard. Neither converse follows.

BOUNDARY_POWER_IMAGE_CALCULATION:
  Let K_Z1,K_Z2 be any two members of R_K_out_R1(Z). Their difference H_Z
  lies in Z_phys and hence
    i_boundary^*H_Z[deltaZ]=0
  for every deltaZ. Therefore
    <K_Z1[deltaZ],C_W[Z]>=<K_Z2[deltaZ],C_W[Z]>.
  Define the frozen trace value
    p_g(Z):=<g_Z[D_uZ],C_W[Z]> : E/T.
  The complete boundary-power image is consequently not a freely widened
  numeric interval. It is exactly
    R_P_out_R1(Z)
      ={p_g(Z)}
        if R_K_out_R1(Z) is nonempty and the same member's complete
        face/bulk Stokes identity derives p_g(Z)=S_in^CT,
      =empty otherwise.
  Thus the 3-form output can have homogeneous relative-cohomology freedom
  while its oriented boundary power is fixed by the prescribed trace.
  This empty-or-singleton conclusion is a set calculation, not a choice of
  midpoint, zero, minimum norm or representative.

GLOBAL_EXACT_BOUNDARY_IMAGE:
  The exact global-operator boundary image obeys
    R_P_exact(Z) subseteq R_P_out_R1(Z).
  Hence, whenever the state-local output set is nonempty, every future exact
  global Kbridge value at the same Z would have to produce the same p_g(Z).
  The statement does not prove that such a global operator exists.

RESERVOIR_PREIMAGE_CALCULATION:
  For a supplied real p the unguarded ledger solution is
    S_aff[Z;p,P_rec]
      ={x0(p,P_rec)+alpha*v_alpha+beta*v_beta+gamma*v_gamma:
        alpha,beta,gamma in R},
    x0(p,P_rec)=(p-P_rec,0,0,P_rec,0)^T,
    v_alpha=(0,1,0,-1,0)^T,
    v_beta=(0,0,1,-1,0)^T,
    v_gamma=(-1,0,0,0,1)^T.
  The two ledger rows are independent, so rank(A)=2, nullity(A)=3 and
  S_aff is nonempty for every supplied real p. Frozen reservoir guards form
    A_res[Z;p,P_rec]=S_aff[Z;p,P_rec] intersect G_res(Z),
  which may be empty and whose nonemptiness is not decided by rank alone.
  Since R_P_out_R1 is empty or {p_g}, the typed reservoir preimage is
    R_P_res_R1(Z)
      ={p_g(Z)}
        if p_g(Z) is in R_P_out_R1(Z) and
           A_res[Z;p_g(Z),P_rec] is nonempty,
      =empty otherwise,
  and the complete coupled reservoir output is
    R_res_out_R1(Z)
      =A_res[Z;p_g(Z),P_rec]
        under the same nonempty condition,
      =empty otherwise.
  No alpha,beta,gamma direction is selected and the guarded fiber need not
  retain affine dimension three after additional exact guards.

CURRENT_CORPUS_EVALUATION:
  The accepted corpus supplies Y_Z templates and the exact RG1-RG4/OR1-OR8R1
  test, but it does not supply complete evaluated face/bulk data over the
  declared reachable D_SV, one explicit K_Zphys, or a state-local existence
  theorem proving R_K_out_R1 nonempty. It also supplies no guarded reservoir
  witness for the resulting conditional p_g. Conversely it supplies no
  exact nonzero obstruction or contradiction proving either set empty on
  the complete reachable scope.

  STATE_LOCAL_GEOMETRIC_OBSTRUCTION, EXACT_IMAGE_RELATION, boundary-power
  and reservoir calculations, current-corpus evaluation, decision branches

GEOMETRIC_AFFINE_FIBER_ONLY:
  At fixed Z define
    R_geom_lin(Z)={K_Z in L_Z:D_Z K_Z=Y_Z}.
  If one geometric lift K_Z0 exists, then and only at this linear equation
  layer
    R_geom_lin(Z)=K_Z0+ker(D_Z),
  with
    ker(D_Z)
      ={H_Z in L_Z:
        i_boundary^*H_Z[deltaZ]=0 and dH_Z[deltaZ]=0
        for every deltaZ}.
  This is the exact affine statement. It does not yet impose any nonlinear
  or inequality physical guard.

GUARD_CUT_OUTPUT_RANGES:
  Let G_outer(Z) denote the frozen no-new-content and output-typing
  predicates, and G_phys(Z) denote OR1-OR8R1, including all quotient,
  kernel, traction-sector, owner, causality, source, regularity, stability,
  units, null-limit and bridge/output no-double-count predicates. Then
    R_K_outer(Z)=R_geom_lin(Z) intersect G_outer(Z),
    R_K_out_R1(Z)
      =R_geom_lin(Z) intersect G_outer(Z) intersect G_phys(Z).
  No affine, linear, convex, connected or translation-invariant structure
  is assigned to either guard-cut set unless separately proved.

RELATIVE_DESCRIPTION_WITHOUT_HOMOGENEITY_OVERCLAIM:
  If one physical member K_Zphys in R_K_out_R1(Z) exists, define
    H_adm(Z;K_Zphys)
      ={H_Z in ker(D_Z):
        K_Zphys+H_Z is in G_outer(Z) intersect G_phys(Z)}.
  Exactly
    R_K_out_R1(Z)=K_Zphys+H_adm(Z;K_Zphys).
  The set H_adm contains zero but is not called a vector space,
  homogeneous space, affine direction set or cohomology group. In
  particular H1,H2 in H_adm does not imply H1+H2 or t*H1 is admissible.

EXACT_IMAGE_INCLUSION_PRESERVED:
  Every accepted global mathcal K in mathfrak A_K satisfies the same fixed
  trace/bulk equations and output guards, hence
    R_K_exact(Z) subseteq R_K_out_R1(Z) subseteq R_K_outer(Z).
  No converse or nonemptiness follows.

FIXED_TRACE_BOUNDARY_IMAGE_PRESERVED:
  For any K_Z1,K_Z2 in R_K_out_R1(Z), both lie in the same R_geom_lin fiber,
  so H_Z=K_Z1-K_Z2 is in ker(D_Z) and
    i_boundary^*H_Z[deltaZ]=0.
  Therefore their complete oriented boundary integrals agree. With
    p_g(Z)=<g_Z[D_uZ],C_W[Z]>:E/T,

      ={p_g(Z)}

        derivation proves p_g(Z)=S_in^CT,
      =empty otherwise.
  This conclusion uses only common trace membership, not affine closure of
  the guard-cut set, and does not select p_g.

RESERVOIR_PREIMAGE_PRESERVED:
  For supplied p, the unguarded solution fiber S_aff has rank(A)=2,
  nullity(A)=3 and is nonempty. The guarded fiber
    A_res[Z;p,P_rec]=S_aff[Z;p,P_rec] intersect G_res(Z)
  may be empty. Consequently

      =empty otherwise,

  empty otherwise. No reservoir null direction or guarded-fiber geometry is
  selected or inferred.

Q1R6_Z0_RESULT_BODY_BEGIN
SOURCE_SCOPE_EVALUATED:
  Exactly one source-fixed midpoint z=0 was assessed. The frozen source
  fixes phi_1(0)=(phi_1^-+phi_1^+)/2 and the displayed benchmark ansatz has
  h(0)=h0/2. The labels m_s=103.8 GeV, lambda_hs=0.72, lambda_s=1 and
  v_w=0.57 were used only to identify the frozen reference benchmark.

QZ0_0_PROVENANCE_AND_LOCUS: PASS
  Archive277A, receipts277B/279A, prereg279 and accepted result280 hashes
  match task532. The midpoint is source-fixed and no second point, scan,
  plot digitisation, fit or reconstructed profile value was introduced.

QZ0_1_FULL_TOTAL_T_AT_MIDPOINT: INPUT_INCOMPLETE
  The source gives exact symbolic definitions
    T_Q=T_phi+T_eq+T_out
  and conservation partial_mu T_Q^(mu nu)=0. It does not provide in the
  frozen text/archive a closed analytic or tabulated evaluation at z=0 of
  the complete benchmark profile needed to evaluate every component of
  T_Q, including h0,s0,L_h,L_s,delta_s,T(0),v_plasma(0) and all required
  Delta_mn^i(0) entering T_out. The plotted Delta functions are not raw
  values and were not digitised. Symbolic availability is not a fixed Z0
  tensor value.

QZ0_2_SIGNATURE_DICTIONARY: PASS_AT_TENSOR_LEVEL
  Let eta_plus=diag(+1,-1,-1,-1) be the source convention and
  g_minus=-eta_plus=diag(-1,+1,+1,+1) the project convention. In one common
  oriented orthonormal coordinate basis retain the contravariant physical
  tensor components T_project^(ab)=T_source^(ab). The same future component
  vector has eta_plus(u,u)=+1 and g_minus(u,u)=-1; lowering its index changes
  sign. Hence
    T_project^a_b=T^(ac)g_minus_cb=-T_source^a_b,
  while partial_a T^(ab)=0 is unchanged. The eigenvectors are preserved and
  eigenvalue signs are translated explicitly. No source field is imported.

QZ0_3_LANDAU_CERTIFICATE: RANGE_DERIVED_CANDIDATE_UNDECIDED
  In the project interface-adapted 1+1 orthonormal frame write
    E=T^(00), q=T^(0n), P_n=T^(nn), S=E+P_n,
    T^a_b=[[-E,q],[-q,P_n]].
  For u_cell=gamma_L(1,v_L), the eigenproblem
    T^a_b u_cell^b=-rho_L u_cell^a
  gives
    q*v_L^2-S*v_L+q=0,
    rho_L=E-q*v_L.
  For q!=0, the two roots have product one. Exactly one is subluminal iff
    Delta_L=S^2-4*q^2>0, equivalently |S|>2|q|,
  and the unique subluminal root is
    v_L=(S-sgn(S)*sqrt(Delta_L))/(2*q)
       =2*q/(S+sgn(S)*sqrt(Delta_L)).
  For q=0, v_L=0 is the unique 1+1 root only if S!=0. In both cases the
  complete task297 gate additionally requires full Hawking-Ellis Type I,
  future orientation, a simple timelike eigenvalue and
    -rho_L != lambda_A
  for every spacelike eigenvalue, plus a smooth branch on the declared
  reachable neighbourhood. QZ0-1 lacks the midpoint values and neighbourhood
  evaluation, so this is an exact allowed range, not a Q1R6 Landau PASS.
  v_w=0.57 and u_plasma cannot substitute for v_L or u_cell.

QZ0_4_INTERFACE_TO_SIGMA_PREP_GEOMETRY: PARTIAL_INPUT_INCOMPLETE
  The source supplies a regular candidate midpoint level surface, wall
  normal/tangent directions and planar wall coordinate. No accepted frozen
  identification maps that source geometry into the existing Sigma_prep
  and parent causal worldtube with its full cap/side/corner chain and without
  an additional dimensional identification. Source thickness and masses
  were not promoted to a theory scale.

QZ0_5_PARENT_OWNER: INPUT_INCOMPLETE
  Q1R6 supplies no pre-event B_rec and therefore no unique binary 0/1 parent
  owner. Wall propagation direction and u_plasma are not owner rules.

QZ0_6_SAME_STATE_CURRENT: INPUT_INCOMPLETE
  Frozen source main.tex defines no conserved current evaluated at the
  midpoint. Its status is UNSPECIFIED, not zero. No current was manufactured
  from u_plasma, particle distributions or T_Q.

QZ0_7_COMPLETE_I7_AND_RESERVOIR_PROVENANCE: INPUT_INCOMPLETE
  The source has no complete invariant tangent packet, parent worldtube
  chain/weights, evaluated g_Z,F_Z,D_Z,Y_Z,D_uZ, same-member EC0-EC5 guard
  receipts, P_rec, E_res or disjoint G_res channel provenance. In particular
  T_phi+T_plasma is not a P_rec or reservoir decomposition, and no reset is
  supplied or inferred.

CERTIFICATE_RESULT:
  D_OW^cert=D_OE^cert=D_RW^cert=D_RE^cert=empty for this assessed source
  packet corpus. This is certificate absence caused by incomplete packet
  inputs, not physical emptiness. No OW, OE, RW or RE certificate exists.

DECISION_BRANCH:
  Q1R6_Z0_LANDAU_RANGE_ONLY_PACKET_INCOMPLETE / LIVE_WAITING.
  QZ0-0 and QZ0-2 pass, the exact planar Landau allowed range is derived,
  and QZ0-1 plus QZ0-4..QZ0-7 remain input-incomplete. The midpoint is not
  certified inside or outside D_7. No candidate, mechanism or parent track
  is excluded.

EXACT_REACTIVATION_PACKET:
  Freeze on the same source midpoint: (1) exact full total T_Q components
  including T_out and a regular neighbourhood; (2) an existing covariant
  map of source interface geometry to Sigma_prep and the complete parent
  worldtube chain; (3) unique owner from existing pre-event B_rec; (4) an
  existing same-state current if required by g_Z/F_Z; and (5) full I_7,
  P_rec,E_res and disjoint G_res provenance. Each item must be existing
  evidence, not a new field, scale, split, owner rule, reset or fit.

NONCLAIMS:
  No complete Z0, Q1R6 Landau PASS/fail, physical empty/nonempty output or
  reservoir set, OW/OE/RW/RE, P_rec split, owner, current, reset, global
  K_bridge, W10 witness, dynamics, observable prediction or parent closure.

JOINT_ALLOWED_SET_CONTRACT_BODY_BEGIN
PRECEDENCE_AND_SCOPE:
  Accepted contracts295R1,297,313R1, task519 output typing, task525
  certificate logic and task535 Landau-range result remain immutable inputs.
  This task supersedes only task538's waiting-only next action by Martin's
  new author decision. Q1R6 remains an accepted E3 reference source whose
  exact midpoint packet is incomplete; it is not reset, fitted or promoted
  to theory input. D2SW8 asks the weaker and prior existence question:
  whether at least one nontrivial joint state class built only from the
  existing RW1 objects is compatible with the exact accepted identities and
  all applicable physical guards.

ESTABLISHED_FRAMEWORK_REGISTER:
  EF0 Lorentzian tensor calculus, exterior forms, Cartan's identity and the
      oriented Stokes theorem are exact mathematical identities (E0).
  EF1 For symmetric T_CT and Q_CT^nu=nabla_mu T_CT^(mu nu), the Noether
      energy-current identity
        nabla_mu(T_CT^(mu nu) xi_nu)
          =Q_CT^nu xi_nu
           +(1/2)T_CT^(mu nu)(L_xi g)_(mu nu)
      is exact (E0); no Killing field and no Q_CT=0 assumption is made.
  EF2 The Landau/Hawking-Ellis Type-I construction is exact only on the
      already accepted regular domain: unique future unit timelike
      eigendirection, simple timelike eigenvalue, transverse
      nondegeneracy and smooth branch. It is a domain condition, not a
      universal assertion about every stress tensor.
  EF3 The covariant material-worldtube/Reynolds transport statement is used
      only as the Cartan pullback identity on an existing smooth embedding
      and a unique material generator. It supplies kinematics, not a new
      surface field or constitutive law.
  EF4 Causality, regularity, stability, source-off/null limits and
      no-double-count conditions remain the frozen OR1-OR8R1 and EC0-EC5
      guards. No additional energy condition is declared a universal law;
      any stronger classical positivity condition may define only a
      sufficient subfamily.
  EF5 The rank(A)=2, nullity(A)=3 reservoir balance and its guarded affine
      fiber are exact accepted linear algebra. Thermodynamic/passive sign
      restrictions are sufficient guard cuts, not a selected channel law.
  No observational tolerance is used in this atom. A measured constraint
  may enter only later with a frozen observable map, dataset, covariance and
  coverage rule under FS-GATE-02.

EXISTING_OBJECTS_ONLY:
  For Z in D_7=D_* intersect D_owner retain
    Z_rec=[B_rec,Sigma_prep]_rel,
    u=u_cell[T_loc[Z]],
    T_CT=Pi_CT T_loc[Z],
    T_CT^(mu nu)=rho_L u^mu u^nu+S_CT^(mu nu),
    j_CT^mu=-T_CT^(mu nu)u_nu=rho_L u^mu,
    Q_CT^nu=nabla_mu T_CT^(mu nu),
    C_W[Z], D_uZ, P_rec=omega_bulk^CT(D_uZ), E_res and G_res.
  j_CT is the accepted energy current derived from the same T_CT. No absent
  charge, particle-number or source current is set to zero or manufactured.
  If an independent current is required by a declared source model, that
  model remains incomplete until the current has exact lineage.

NOETHER_CARTAN_BRIDGE_CANDIDATE:
  On the subdomain where the complete state tangent has an existing unique
  linear quotient-covariant material generator, write for every deltaZ
    xi[deltaZ]=N[deltaZ] u+v[deltaZ],  u.v=0.
  Define pointwise, before any integration,
    j_N^mu[deltaZ]
      :=T_CT^(mu nu)xi_nu
       =-N[deltaZ] j_CT^mu+S_CT^(mu nu)v_nu[deltaZ],
    K_N[Z;deltaZ]:=i_(j_N[deltaZ]) epsilon_g.
  This map is linear in deltaZ when deltaZ->xi is linear. Its exact bulk
  derivative is
    dK_N
      =[Q_CT.xi+(1/2)T_CT:L_xi g] epsilon_g.
  Its pullback to an oriented face F is the full flux/work density
    i_F^*K_N=T_CT^(mu nu)xi_nu dSigma_mu.
  Thus the cap component contains the Landau energy-current sector and the
  side component contains the normal+mixed traction work; moving-face,
  metric and embedding effects remain in the actual xi, dSigma and
  L_xi g. No term is dropped by a static-frame convention.

  K_N is a candidate, not a PASS by definition. The bounded result must
  verify on one declared complete tangent scope that its cap trace equals
  the accepted g_Z cap/storage/inertial target, its side/corner traces equal
  the accepted normal+mixed traction targets with the identical owner
  weights, and its bulk derivative equals the complete F_Z target. A trace
  mismatch, missing intrinsic state variation or incomplete tangent map
  cannot be hidden by defining g_Z or F_Z from K_N after the fact.

JOINT_ACTIVE_ALLOWED_SET:
  Define the certificate-level active correspondence
    A_joint^*(D_N)
      :={(Z,K_N,p,x):
          Z is in D_N subseteq D_7,
          every EC0-EC5 item has existing same-member lineage,
          K_N is in R_K_out_R1(Z),
          p=<K_N[D_uZ],C_W[Z]>=S_in^CT>0,
          x is in A_res[Z;p,P_rec(Z)]}.
  D_N is not a new state space. It is the subset of the existing D_7 on
  which the full-tangent generator, complete oriented worldtube chain,
  Noether/Cartan bridge data and all frozen guards are evaluable.
  The source-off stratum A_joint^0 with p=0 is recorded separately. Its
  nonemptiness may test a null limit but cannot by itself establish an
  active RW1 mechanism.

FULL_TANGENT_AND_OWNER_GATES:
  J0 the map deltaZ->xi is defined linearly on one proved-complete basis of
     the entire T_Z and descends through pure relabel directions;
  J1 the unique future Landau u and the T_CT decomposition are smooth on a
     regular neighbourhood;
  J2 every shared face has one pre-event B_rec owner, sum_p w_(p,c)=1, and
     the same w*s in cap, side, complement and reservoir ledgers;
  J3 K_N cap, side and corner pullbacks equal the independently frozen g_Z
     targets, including intrinsic variation, measure and embedding terms;
  J4 dK_N equals the complete F_Z target with Q_CT, metric, acceleration,
     expansion, geometry and source terms retained;
  J5 the same-member oriented Stokes identity proves p=S_in^CT with units
     E/T; scalar equality alone is insufficient;
  J6 OR1-OR8R1, covariance, causality, regularity, stability, source-off,
     null-limit, kernel and bridge/output no-double-count guards pass;
  J7 P_rec is the existing omega_bulk(D_uZ), not a fitted split, and every
     reservoir channel has disjoint same-member provenance;
  J8 one complete guarded x or an exact existence theorem proves the
     reservoir fiber nonempty at the same p and Z.

RESERVOIR_SUFFICIENT_RANGE_WITHOUT_SELECTION:
  The accepted balance is
    P_store+P_diss+P_RW1export=P_rec,
    D_uE_res+P_rec+L_ext=p.
  A conservative passive sufficient subset, only when compatible with all
  frozen G_res predicates and channel provenance, is
    p>0,
    0<=P_rec<=p,
    P_store>=0, P_diss>=0, P_RW1export>=0,
    P_store+P_diss+P_RW1export=P_rec,
    0<=L_ext<=p-P_rec,
    D_uE_res=p-P_rec-L_ext>=0.
  For every supplied p and P_rec satisfying these inequalities the simplex
  of the three internal channels and the interval for L_ext are nonempty.
  This is a set-valued existence lemma, not a choice of midpoint, equal
  split, minimum norm, null direction or unique reservoir law. J7 and every
  remaining G_res predicate still must pass on the same member.

BOUNDED_ANALYTIC_QUESTIONS_AFTER_DUAL_CONTRACT_PASS:

  JA2 decide whether K_N supplies the complete independent cap/side/corner

  JA5 return the entire accepted joint correspondence and separately list
      what remains for a global local-natural K_bridge, D2I, D3-D6,
      dynamics and observables.

DECISION_BRANCHES:
  JOINT_ACTIVE_RANGE_EXISTENCE_PASS_STATE_LOCAL:
    one explicit p>0 same-member witness or a valid existence theorem proves
    A_joint^* nonempty on a declared existing subdomain; this does not prove
    a global local-natural K_bridge or an observational result.
  JOINT_SOURCE_OFF_RANGE_ONLY:
    only A_joint^0 is proved nonempty; null consistency passes but active
    RW1 existence remains open.
  JOINT_RANGE_CONDITIONAL_OPEN:
    exact joint constraints and sufficient ranges are derived but J0-J8 do
    not yet prove or refute active nonemptiness.
  JOINT_EMPTY_EXACT_SUBSCOPE_CERTIFIED:
    an exact contradiction proves A_joint^* empty only on the declared
    subdomain; parent closure requires the S1-S4 finding process and Martin.
  INVALID_CONTRACT_OR_MATERIAL_FINDING:
    classify P0/T1/S1-S4 and return to the earliest valid point.

NONCLAIMS:
  No exact Q1R6 midpoint is reconstructed. No independent current is set to
  zero. No new field, scale, topology, causal edge, surface dynamics,
  hidden memory, equation of state, fit or observational tolerance is
  introduced. Contract freeze is not a witness. A state-local nonempty
  joint range would not prove cross-state coherence, one global K_bridge,
  D2I, D3-D6, P5.4, G8, G9, A3 or global theory feasibility. Failure or
  incompleteness leaves the parent C01-RW1/A2-K4 track LIVE/WAITING.
JOINT_ALLOWED_SET_CONTRACT_BODY_END

JA1_EXACT_NOETHER_CARTAN_CALCULATION:
  Use signature u.u=-1, S_CT^(mu nu)u_nu=0 and
    xi[deltaZ]=N[deltaZ]u+v[deltaZ], u.v=0.
  Then
    T_CT^(mu nu)xi_nu
      =rho_L u^mu u^nu(Nu_nu+v_nu)+S_CT^(mu nu)v_nu
      =-N rho_L u^mu+S_CT^(mu nu)v_nu
      =-N j_CT^mu+S_CT^(mu nu)v_nu.
  Therefore
    K_N[deltaZ]=i_(T_CT.xi[deltaZ])epsilon_g
  is a covariant three-form and is linear in deltaZ exactly when the
  existing quotient-covariant generator Xi_Z:deltaZ->xi[deltaZ] is linear.
  For symmetric T_CT,
    nabla_mu(T_CT^(mu nu)xi_nu)
      =(nabla_mu T_CT^(mu nu))xi_nu
       +T_CT^(mu nu)nabla_mu xi_nu
      =Q_CT.xi+(1/2)T_CT:L_xi g,
  hence
    dK_N=[Q_CT.xi+(1/2)T_CT:L_xi g]epsilon_g.
  No Killing assumption and no Q_CT=0 assumption entered. The face pullback
    i_F^*K_N=T_CT^(mu nu)xi_nu dSigma_mu
  has the accepted flux/work units; evaluated on deltaZ=D_uZ and integrated
  on C_W it has units E/T. The sign follows the frozen orientation and is
  not independently adjustable.

JA2_COMPLETE_TANGENT_FACTORIZATION_TEST:
  Let
    Xi_Z:T_Z->Gamma(TW_pc), Xi_Z(deltaZ)=xi[deltaZ],
    N_T,Z(xi)=i_(T_CT.xi)epsilon_g,
    D_ZK=(i_boundary^*K,dK),
    Y_Z=(g_Z,F_Z).
  The candidate is a complete state-local output exactly only if, on one
  proved-complete tangent and the identical owner-weighted worldtube chain,
    Y_Z=D_Z compose N_T,Z compose Xi_Z.
  Equivalently every deltaZ must have zero independent residuals
    R_g[deltaZ]
      :=g_Z[deltaZ]-i_boundary^*K_N[deltaZ]=0,
    R_F[deltaZ]
      :=F_Z[deltaZ]
        -[Q_CT.xi[deltaZ]+(1/2)T_CT:L_(xi[deltaZ])g]epsilon_g=0,
  together with zero face-overlap/corner compatibility residual using the
  same w_(p,c)*s_(p,c). A necessary kernel test is
    ker(Xi_Z) subseteq ker(Y_Z).
  Thus any physical intrinsic deltaZ_int with Xi_Z(deltaZ_int)=0 but
  Y_Z(deltaZ_int)!=0 is an exact failure of this candidate on that scope.
  Conversely the Noether identity proves the diffeomorphic/material
  transport sector but does not by itself prove intrinsic, measure, metric,
  embedding, moving-face or corner response. These are residual tests, not
  new fields or correction terms.

  The accepted corpus provides the Y_Z typing and guard templates, but no
  independently evaluated complete basis of T_Z with paired Xi_Z,g_Z,F_Z
  and owner-weighted face/corner data for one existing Z. It therefore
  proves neither R_g=R_F=0 on a complete active member nor a nonzero
  residual contradiction. J0,J3,J4 and consequently J5 remain unevaluated,
  not failed.

JA3_GUARDED_ACTIVE_VERSUS_SOURCE_OFF_RANGE:
  Define the exact candidate domain without enlarging the state space,
    D_N^adm
      :={Z in D_7:
          J0-J7 pass on the same member,
          R_g=0 and R_F=0 on all T_Z,
          all corner/owner residuals vanish}.
  For Z in D_N^adm set
    p_N(Z)=<K_N[D_uZ],C_W[Z]>.
  The active candidate fiber exists only on the further cut
    p_N(Z)=S_in^CT(Z)>0
  and only if J8 supplies a same-member guarded reservoir member. The
  source-off cut p_N=0 is disjoint and cannot certify active RW1. Current
  evidence supplies no complete Z in either cut and no exact contradiction
  excluding either cut. All OR1-OR8R1 and EC0-EC5 guards remain conjunctive;
  none is replaced by a generic classical energy condition.

JA4_PASSIVE_RESERVOIR_SET_CALCULATION:
  For supplied p>0 and 0<=P_rec<=p define
    Delta_2(P_rec)
      :={(a,b,c) in R_+^3:a+b+c=P_rec},
    I(p,P_rec):=[0,p-P_rec].
  Both sets are nonempty. The entire passive ledger subset is
    S_pass(p,P_rec)
      :={(p-P_rec-L,a,b,c,L):
          (a,b,c) in Delta_2(P_rec), L in I(p,P_rec)}.
  In the accepted variable order this gives
    D_uE_res=p-P_rec-L>=0,
    P_store=a>=0, P_diss=b>=0, P_RW1export=c>=0, L_ext=L>=0,
  and satisfies both balance rows identically. This proves a set-valued
  algebraic/passive range without choosing a vertex, midpoint, equal split,
  minimum norm or null direction.

  The physical guarded fiber is still
    S_pass(p,P_rec) intersect G_res(Z)
  with disjoint same-member channel provenance. The current corpus has no
  complete J7 provenance certificate or G_res witness at one Z and p_N(Z).
  Hence J8 nonemptiness is not established, while guarded emptiness is also
  not established.

JA5_COMPLETE_BOUNDED_CORRESPONDENCE_AND_DECISION:
  The established-physics candidate correspondence is exactly
    A_N^*
      :={(Z,K_N,p,x):
          Z in D_N^adm,
          p=p_N(Z)=S_in^CT(Z)>0,
          0<=P_rec(Z)<=p,
          x in S_pass(p,P_rec(Z)) intersect G_res(Z),
          J8 and all same-member lineage guards pass}.
  Its source-off analogue A_N^0 is the separate p=0 cut. This is the full
  result allowed by the frozen evidence: A_N^* is a precisely testable set,
  but current evidence proves neither A_N^* nonempty nor empty.

SCIENTIFIC_INFORMATION_GAIN_AND_SMALLEST_NEXT_INPUT:
  Established covariance, Noether stress-energy balance, Cartan/Stokes
  transport and the accepted affine reservoir ledger reduce the unknown
  state-local bridge question to one exact factorization/residual test
    Y_Z=D_Z compose N_T,Z compose Xi_Z

  predicates. An exact theorem establishing the same factorization and one
  guarded reservoir member on a declared existing subdomain is equivalent.
  No Q1R6 midpoint, new field, constitutive scale or fitted tolerance is

REMAINING_AFTER_STATE_LOCAL_TEST:
  Even a future nonempty A_N^* would still leave the global local-natural
  K_bridge/cross-state coherence, D2I, D3-D6, well-posed dynamics, P5.4,
