```text
D2SW9_PHYSICS_PRIOR_CANDIDATE_ENSEMBLE_BODY_BEGIN
PRECEDENCE_AND_SCOPE:
  Accepted task542 remains the immutable immediate scientific input. This
  task supersedes only task546's waiting-only next action by Martin's new
  author decision. It does not replace the accepted factorization test,
  Landau regular-domain guards, owner/worldtube rules, reservoir balances or
  any immutable upstream evidence. The atom constructs a finite, auditable
  search prior over existing-object same-track candidates; it does not claim
  that the finite roster is an exhaustive partition of mathematical laws.

EVIDENCE_AND_RANKING_SEMANTICS:
  E0 exact identities and accepted route guards are hard filters with no
  tolerance. Established continuum, thermodynamic, hyperbolic, kinetic and
  interface frameworks are E2 reference families unless an exact identity
  is separately displayed. Their use demonstrates physical motivation, not
  that a candidate is true in this theory. No E1 observational ranking is
  performed because no frozen model-to-observable map, dataset, covariance
  and coverage rule exists for this atom.

  PHYSICS_PRIOR_RANK is ordinal, not a fitted probability or posterior. A
  higher rank means, in order: no new field/state/scale/topology/causal rule;
  exact covariance and conservation compatibility; fewer unproved lineage
  inputs; lower local derivative order; causal/well-posed evolution;
  stability/passivity; unique covariant owner; and disjoint reservoir
  provenance. Exact failure of any mandatory guard rejects the package.
  Missing evidence yields LIVE/WAITING, never rejection. Ties remain a
  set-valued tier and are not broken by a label, midpoint or fit.

EXISTING_OBJECTS_AND_HARD_GUARDS:
  Use only Z_rec=[B_rec,Sigma_prep]_rel, the accepted regular Type-I Landau
  u_cell[T_loc[Z]], T_CT=Pi_CT T_loc, j_CT, Q_CT, the parent causal
  worldtube C_W, existing E_res/P_rec/G_res, accepted owner weights and the
  task542 operators Xi_Z, N_T,Z, D_Z and Y_Z=(g_Z,F_Z). Every candidate must
  preserve OR1-OR8R1, EC0-EC5, source-off separation, exact units, covariance,
  locality, conservation, causality, stability, face/corner glue and the
  same-member no-double-count ledger. No absent current, entropy field,
  temperature, relaxation time, transition rate or coefficient is set to
  zero or invented.

INTRINSIC_STATE_DIRECTION_REGISTER_MAX8:
  I0 TRANSPORT_COMPLETE: ker(Xi_Z) contains only pure relabel directions and
     the material generator spans the physical quotient tangent. This is a
     testable minimal hypothesis, not an assumption of completeness.
  I1 LANDAU_ENERGY_SCALAR: variation of the existing simple Landau
     eigenvalue rho_L of T_CT on the accepted regular domain.
  I2 SPATIAL_STRESS_IRREDUCIBLES: trace and traceless spatial variations of
     the existing S_CT relative to u_cell; no new stress tensor.
  I3 INTERFACE_EMBEDDING_GEOMETRY: normal/shape, induced-measure and
     extrinsic-geometry variations of the existing Sigma_prep.
  I4 FIXED_GRAPH_BOND_CAPACITY: variations of existing B_rec capacities or
     weights with incidence graph and causal orientation fixed.
  I5 FIXED_GRAPH_BOND_ANISOTROPY: variations of existing bond directions or
     anisotropic geometry with no edge creation, deletion or rewiring.
  I6 EXISTING_CURRENT_OR_SOURCE_MODE: admitted only when an independent
     current/source is already part of the same frozen state with exact
     lineage; otherwise this family is unavailable, not zero.
  I7 CONSTRAINED_STRESS_GEOMETRY_MODE: a coupled combination of I1-I5 forced
     by an existing conservation, compatibility or interface constraint;
     it adds no independent degree of freedom.

CONSTITUTIVE_GZ_FZ_RESPONSE_REGISTER_MAX8:
  G1 NOETHER_CARTAN_FACTORIZED_TRANSPORT: Y_Z=D_Z o N_T,Z o Xi_Z, with the
     full task542 residual and kernel tests.
  G2 LOCAL_ALGEBRAIC_STRESS_GEOMETRY: zeroth-jet covariant response built
     only from existing T_CT, B_rec, Sigma_prep and their accepted invariants.
  G3 INTEGRABLE_EXISTING_ENERGY_HESSIAN: exact first/second variation of the
     existing E_res or stored bond/interface energy, only with frozen
     functional lineage and the required mixed-partial integrability.
  G4 COVARIANT_INTERFACE_TRACTION_JUMP: full normal+mixed traction and moving
     worldtube response from the same T_CT, with cap/side/corner glue.
  G5 ONSAGER_PASSIVE_SPATIAL_RESPONSE: symmetric positive-semidefinite
     dissipative response on the spatial quotient; every coefficient must be
     derived from existing state data and units, never fitted.
  G6 GENERIC_METRIPLECTIC_RESPONSE: antisymmetric reversible plus symmetric
     positive-semidefinite dissipative response on the existing state, with
     exact degeneracy conditions and no extra entropy state.
  G7 FIRST_JET_SYMMETRIC_HYPERBOLIC_RESPONSE: local first-jet response whose
     principal symbol is symmetric hyperbolic and causal on the frozen
     domain, without a new coefficient scale.
  G8 CAUSAL_RELAXATION_RESPONSE: Maxwell-Cattaneo/Israel-Stewart-type family
     only if every relaxation scale is uniquely derived from existing
     geometry/state invariants; otherwise it is unavailable in this scope.

EVOLUTION_DUZ_REGISTER_MAX9:
  D1 MATERIAL_LIE_TRANSPORT: covariant Lie/convective evolution along the
     existing u_cell and material worldtube generator.
  D2 CONSTRAINED_HAMILTONIAN: conservative Poisson/Hamiltonian flow generated
     by an existing energy and constraint structure.
  D3 ONSAGER_GRADIENT_FLOW: passive dissipative flow generated by an existing
     energy/entropy functional and positive mobility with exact lineage.
  D4 GENERIC_METRIPLECTIC_FLOW: compatible D2+D3 sum satisfying antisymmetry,
     positivity and both degeneracy conditions.
  D5 SYMMETRIC_HYPERBOLIC_BALANCE: first-order causal balance law with
     positive time block and frozen characteristic-speed guard.
  D6 CONSTRAINED_DAE_FLOW: differential-algebraic evolution enforcing the
     existing B_rec/Sigma_prep, conservation, owner and ledger constraints.
  D7 CAUSAL_RELAXATION_FLOW: admitted only with an existing-derived positive
     relaxation time and a stable hyperbolic limit.
  D8 EXISTING_KINETIC_MOMENT_FLOW: admitted only if the frozen state already
     contains the required distribution/current and closure lineage.
  D9 FIXED_GRAPH_MASTER_FLOW: local bond-transition/master equation on the
     existing graph only if all rates are derived, nonnegative and satisfy
     the declared balance/detailed-balance guard; no new stochastic field.

RESERVOIR_PROVENANCE_REGISTER_MAX8:
  R1 ORIENTED_CONTROL_VOLUME: attribute power by disjoint oriented face
     labels and the unique accepted owner weights from the same worldtube.
  R2 REVERSIBLE_STORAGE: only an exact D_uE_res contribution with frozen
     functional lineage may enter storage.
  R3 ENTROPY_PRODUCTION_DISSIPATION: only a nonnegative irreversible term
     with an existing entropy/temperature lineage may enter dissipation.
  R4 DECLARED_RW1_FACE_EXPORT: only outgoing causal work/flux through the
     declared RW1 face may enter P_RW1export.
  R5 DECLARED_EXTERNAL_BOUNDARY: only a separately declared existing external
     boundary flux may enter L_ext.
  R6 SOURCE_TAGGED_DIRECT_SUM: disjoint R1-R5 projectors whose sum is the
     identity on the accepted power ledger; overlap is forbidden.
  R7 PASSIVE_SIMPLEX_OUTER_RANGE: the accepted task542 simplex/interval is a
     set-valued feasibility range, not a physical attribution law.
  R8 FORCED_VERTEX: pure storage, dissipation or export is allowed only when
     existing source tags force that vertex; it is never selected for
     convenience.

OWNER_REGISTER_MAX8:
  O1 UNIQUE_PRE_EVENT_CAUSAL_PARENT: the accepted strict B_rec causal owner;
     ambiguity remains LIVE/WAITING.
  O2 UNIQUE_INVARIANT_EARLIEST_INTERSECTION: earliest proper-time
     predecessor on the existing pre-event causal chain, only if unique.
  O3 UNIQUE_MAX_INCOMING_ENERGY_FLUX: maximize the invariant incoming T_CT
     flux over existing causal parents; exact tie remains waiting.
  O4 UNIQUE_MAX_TRACTION_WORK: maximize the invariant signed normal+mixed
     traction work; exact tie remains waiting.
  O5 UNIQUE_FIXED_GRAPH_CAPACITY_PREDECESSOR: select a unique existing
     causal predecessor by existing capacity/geodesic data; tie waits.
  O6 COVARIANT_LEXICOGRAPHIC_INVARIANT_TUPLE: causal order, orientation,
     capacity and flux may be ordered only when all are existing invariant
     scalars; no coordinate or identifier tie-break; exact tie waits.
  O7 UNIQUE_PRE_EVENT_LIMIT: owner from a unique perturbative limit of the
     existing pre-event orientation, only when path-independent; else waits.
  O8 SET_VALUED_WAITING_OWNER: retain all admissible parents and make no 0/1
     ledger assignment until ambiguity resolves; this is not an active
     witness but preserves the live branch.

COMPATIBILITY_AND_TOP10_ORDINAL_PACKAGES:
  Rank  Package  Intrinsic  Response  Evolution  Reservoir  Owner
  1 PK1_MINIMAL_NOETHER_MATERIAL
      I0  G1  D1  R1  O1
  2 PK2_COVARIANT_TRACTION_CONSTRAINED
      I1+I2+I3+I4  G2+G4  D6  R1+R2+R4  O1
  3 PK3_HYPERELASTIC_INTERFACE
      I3+I4+I5  G3+G4  D2  R1+R2+R4  O1
  4 PK4_SYMMETRIC_HYPERBOLIC_STRESS_GEOMETRY
      I1+I2+I3+I4  G7  D5  R1+R4  O1
  5 PK5_ONSAGER_PASSIVE
      I1+I2+I4  G5  D3  R6  O1
  6 PK6_GENERIC_REVERSIBLE_DISSIPATIVE
      I1+I2+I3+I4  G6  D4  R6  O1
  7 PK7_ALGEBRAIC_STRESS_FIXED_GRAPH_DAE
      I1+I2+I4+I5  G2  D6  R1+R4  O1
  8 PK8_CAUSAL_RELAXATION_DERIVED_TAU
      I2+I4  G8  D7  R3+R4  O1
  9 PK9_EXISTING_KINETIC_MOMENT
      I1+I2+I6  G7  D8  R6  O1
 10 PK10_FIXED_GRAPH_BOND_MASTER
      I4+I5  G5  D9  R6  O5

  Each package is a conjunction, not a menu from which missing pieces may be
  borrowed after seeing a result. G2+G4 and R1+R2+R4 denote one compatible
  composite with disjoint roles. The registers are families and can overlap;
  their Cartesian product is not a count of physically distinct theories.
  O2-O8 are bounded fallback rules, not license to replace O1 in a package
  after a failed calculation. A new owner choice requires an explicit frozen
  package revision and the same audits.

BOUNDED_ANALYTIC_CALCULATION_AFTER_DUAL_CONTRACT_PASS:
  CA1 apply all E0 and accepted OR/EC hard filters to PK1-PK10; a hard-filter
      failure excludes only the exact package and scope.
  CA2 for every surviving package write its complete quotient tangent basis
      hypothesis and evaluate the task542 necessary condition
        ker(Xi_Z) subseteq ker(Y_Z)
      without defining Y_Z from the candidate.
  CA3 evaluate constitutive integrability, units, derivative order and
      conservation; for D5/D7 also the causal principal-symbol guard, and for
      D3/D4/D9 positivity/degeneracy/rate guards.
  CA4 evaluate O1 uniqueness first, then exact worldtube/corner glue and the
      R1-R8 same-member provenance intersection with the passive range.
  CA5 return an ordered table with exactly one state per package:
      SURVIVES_CURRENT_EXACT_FILTERS, WAITING_MISSING_FROZEN_LINEAGE,
      EXCLUDED_EXACT_DECLARED_SCOPE, or MATERIAL_FINDING. Preserve ties.
  CA6 calculate the next discriminating equation/input for the highest-ranked
      surviving or waiting package. Do not infer a numerical probability.

DECISION_BRANCHES:
  CANDIDATE_ENSEMBLE_REDUCED_AND_RANKED:
    CA1-CA6 produce a guarded ordered survivor/waiting set and one exact next
    calculation; this is progress, not RW1 existence.
  PACKAGE_STATE_LOCAL_EXISTENCE_PASS:
    one complete p>0 same-member package satisfies task542 factorization and
    a guarded reservoir witness on a declared existing subdomain; global
    K_bridge and cross-state dynamics remain open.
  PACKAGE_EXCLUDED_EXACT_DECLARED_SCOPE:
    an exact contradiction excludes only that frozen package and scope.
  ALL_TEN_UNRESOLVED_OR_EXCLUDED:
    the parent remains LIVE/WAITING because the finite top-ten roster is not
    an exhaustive partition of all same-track laws.
  MATERIAL_FINDING:
    classify P0/T1/S1-S4 and return to the earliest valid point.

NONCLAIMS:
  The ranking is not evidence-weighted probability, fit, likelihood or
  observational compatibility. No package is selected as the law. No new
  current, entropy variable, temperature, coefficient, timescale, rate,
  field, topology, owner, reservoir split or null direction is introduced.
  Contract freeze is not audit PASS and authorizes no Python, network, DEV,
  RC, official run, checkpoint, package or publication. Failure of this
  finite roster cannot close C01-RW1, P5 or A2-K4.
```

```text
D2SW9_CA1_CA6_RESULT_BODY_BEGIN
CA1_EXACT_HARD_FILTER_CALCULATION:
  Apply E0 identities and every accepted OR/EC guard before E2 framework
  motivation. The definitions of PK1-PK10 contain no direct contradiction
  with covariance, conservation, locality, units, the regular Landau domain,
  causality, stability, owner accounting or reservoir balance. Therefore no
  package is PRECHECK_EXCLUDED by its definition alone. This is not evidence
  that any package is instantiated: every conditional structure still needs
  frozen existing-state lineage on the same member.

CA2_FACTORISATION_AND_INTRINSIC_DISCRIMINANT:
  At one existing Z let G_rel be the pure-relabel tangent and form the
  quotient Q_Z=T_Z/G_rel. On a proved-complete quotient basis define
    X_Z := matrix/bar-map of Xi_Z:Q_Z -> V_Z,
    Y_Z := matrix/bar-map of independently frozen (g_Z,F_Z,corner_Z):Q_Z -> W_Z,
    L_N,Z := the fixed Noether-Cartan trace/bulk/corner map D_Z o N_T,Z.
  PK1 requires the fixed equality
    E_N(Z):=Y_Z-L_N,Z X_Z=0
  on the entire Q_Z, not a fitted L and not only selected directions.

  Before the fixed-map equality, the exact necessary test for any descent is
    ker(X_Z) subseteq ker(Y_Z).
  If a finite exact presentation of the frozen maps exists, this is
  equivalent to
    rank(vertical_stack(X_Z,Y_Z))=rank(X_Z).
  The rank equality only proves existence of some factor through X_Z; it does
  not replace the stricter fixed Noether residual E_N=0.

  The I0 transport-complete hypothesis further requires
    ker(Xi_Z)=G_rel,
  equivalently ker(X_Z)={0} on Q_Z. Thus the first exact discriminator is:
    (a) if ker(X_Z) is nonzero and Y_Z is nonzero on one kernel vector, PK1
        is excluded on that complete frozen scope and the nonzero response is
        an intrinsic-direction datum for I1-I7 classification;
    (b) if ker(X_Z)={0}, continue to the full fixed residual E_N=0;
    (c) neither branch may be decided from an incomplete basis.

CA3_CONSTITUTIVE_AND_EVOLUTION_PREFILTER:
  PK1 lacks a complete Q_Z basis, paired X_Z/Y_Z and fixed-map residual, so
  its accepted current state is WAITING_MISSING_FROZEN_LINEAGE.
  PK2 lacks the complete I1+I2+I3+I4 response, a frozen G2+G4 law and D6.
  PK3 lacks an existing-energy Hessian with integrability and a frozen
  conservative Poisson/constraint structure.
  PK4 lacks frozen first-jet principal matrices, a positive time block and
  exact characteristic-speed/causal-domain data.
  PK5 lacks an existing entropy/energy gradient and uniquely derived positive
  mobility; passivity alone does not provide them.
  PK6 lacks frozen Poisson and metric brackets, both degeneracy identities
  and existing entropy lineage.
  PK7 lacks the complete algebraic stress response and constrained DAE map.
  PK8 lacks a uniquely existing-derived positive relaxation time and the
  required dissipation provenance.
  PK9 lacks an existing distribution/current and kinetic closure lineage;
  Q1R6 absence of a current is not set to zero.
  PK10 lacks derived nonnegative bond-transition rates, detailed-balance data
  and one unique O5 owner on an existing state.
  All are missing-lineage statements, not exact contradictions.

CA4_OWNER_WORLD_TUBE_AND_RESERVOIR_PREFILTER:
  O1 remains the first owner rule for PK1-PK9 and O5 is frozen only for PK10.
  The current corpus has no candidate-complete same-member state carrying the
  required unique owner, complete oriented cap/side/corner chain, p_N,
  P_rec and disjoint R1-R6 provenance. Hence neither
    p_N=S_in^CT>0,
    0<=P_rec<=p_N,
  nor a same-member intersection with G_res can be evaluated for any package.
  The task542 passive simplex is retained only as an outer algebraic range;
  it cannot fill missing physical channel provenance.

CA5_ORDERED_PACKAGE_TABLE:
  Rank  Package  Current exact state  First missing frozen discriminator
   1  PK1   WAITING_MISSING_FROZEN_LINEAGE  complete Q_Z; X_Z,Y_Z,L_N,Z; O1/R1 witness
   2  PK2   WAITING_MISSING_FROZEN_LINEAGE  I1-I4 basis; G2+G4; D6; provenance
   3  PK3   WAITING_MISSING_FROZEN_LINEAGE  E_res Hessian/integrability; Poisson constraints
   4  PK4   WAITING_MISSING_FROZEN_LINEAGE  principal symbol; positive time block; speeds
   5  PK5   WAITING_MISSING_FROZEN_LINEAGE  energy/entropy gradient; positive mobility
   6  PK6   WAITING_MISSING_FROZEN_LINEAGE  Poisson/metric brackets; degeneracy; entropy
   7  PK7   WAITING_MISSING_FROZEN_LINEAGE  algebraic G2; constrained D6
   8  PK8   WAITING_MISSING_FROZEN_LINEAGE  derived tau>0; hyperbolicity; provenance
   9  PK9   WAITING_MISSING_FROZEN_LINEAGE  existing distribution/current; closure
  10  PK10  WAITING_MISSING_FROZEN_LINEAGE  derived rates; detailed balance; unique O5

  Counts over the frozen top ten are
    SURVIVES_CURRENT_EXACT_FILTERS=0,
    WAITING_MISSING_FROZEN_LINEAGE=10,
    EXCLUDED_EXACT_DECLARED_SCOPE=0,
    MATERIAL_FINDING=0.
  Zero survivors here means no package is presently complete enough to earn
  that state; it is not a zero candidate count and not evidence of emptiness.

CA6_SMALLEST_NEXT_DISCRIMINATING_INPUT_AND_SEQUENCE:
  The highest-prior next calculation remains PK1 because its Noether-Cartan
  map is the only response sector already exact upstream. Supply one existing
  Z with a proved-complete Q_Z basis and independently frozen X_Z,Y_Z,L_N,Z.
  Evaluate, in order:
    C1 nullity(X_Z) and Y_Z restricted to ker(X_Z);
    C2 the full fixed residual E_N=Y_Z-L_N,Z X_Z including corner/owner terms;
    C3 p_N=<K_N[D_uZ],C_W>=S_in^CT>0 on the same member;
    C4 the disjoint-provenance guarded reservoir intersection.
```

```text
CORRECTED_CONTRACT_DELTA_PRECEDENCE:
  The canonical corrected D2SW10 contract is immutable task557 body plus
  this delta. This delta supersedes only task557 sections
  PK1_CAPACITY_KERNEL_THEOREM_OBLIGATION,
  EXACT_EQUIVALENT_SCOPED_THEOREM_ROUTE operative T3 wording,
  BOUNDED_ANALYTIC_CALCULATION KT3-KT5 and DECISION_BRANCHES. All other
  task557 definitions, scope, guards and nonclaims remain unchanged.

CORRECTED_GENERIC_KERNEL_AND_CAPACITY_SUBCASE:
  Define on a proved-complete Q_Z
    K_all(Z):=ker(X_Z),
    K_cap(Z):=V_cap(Z) intersect K_all(Z),
    K_geom(Z):=V_geom(Z) intersect K_all(Z).
  These sets need not exhaust mixed directions. The exhaustive I0 decision
  is:
    G0 incomplete Q_Z -> WAITING; no kernel classification;
    G1 complete Q_Z and there exists nonzero physical deltaZ in K_all(Z)
       -> PK1_I0_KERNEL_EXCLUDED_EXACT_SCOPE;
       G1a deltaZ in K_cap is the capacity-specific subcase;
       G1b deltaZ in K_geom is the geometry-specific subcase;
       G1c every remaining nonzero kernel direction, including mixed, gives
           the same PK1/I0 exclusion;
    G2 complete Q_Z and K_all(Z)={0} -> I0 injectivity passes and only then
       evaluate E_N=Y_Z-L_N,Z X_Z.
  K_cap, K_geom or their sum is never substituted for K_all.

CORRECTED_CAPACITY_LAW_REACH:
  An existing unique quotient-covariant capacity-to-material-generator law
  can prove only injectivity on the capacity sector. It is necessary for a
  nontrivial V_cap sector but not sufficient for K_all={0}. A proved-zero
  V_cap requires an exact existing constraint and tangent derivative, not a
  chosen fixed-capacity slice. Geometry and mixed sectors remain mandatory.

CORRECTED_EQUIVALENT_THEOREM_T3:
  T3 must either exhibit any nonzero physical member of K_all or prove
  K_all={0} on the entire proved-complete Q_Z. Sector-by-sector injectivity
  is sufficient only when a proved direct-sum or otherwise complete spanning
  theorem covers every physical quotient direction.

CORRECTED_BOUNDED_KT3_KT5:
  KT3 apply G0-G2 before all sector-specific refinements;
  KT4 any nonzero physical K_all witness excludes PK1 in the declared scope;
      record capacity, geometry or mixed provenance only as a diagnostic;
  KT5 continue to E_N if and only if Q_Z is complete and K_all={0}.

CORRECTED_DECISION_BRANCHES:
  PK1_I0_KERNEL_EXCLUDED_EXACT_SCOPE:
    complete Q_Z and one nonzero physical member of K_all are proved.
  PK1_I0_INJECTIVE_SCOPE_CONTINUE_TO_FIXED_RESIDUAL:
    complete Q_Z and K_all={0} are proved.
  PK1_QZ_COMPLETENESS_OR_GENERIC_INJECTIVITY_WAITING:
    neither exhaustive branch is proved; exact missing sector/law is listed.
  MATERIAL_FINDING:
    classify P0/T1/S1-S4 and return to the earliest valid point.

NONCLAIMS:
  The correction does not assert that V_cap, V_geom or K_all is nonzero,
  direct-sum, finite-dimensional or complete. It does not choose a
  fixed-capacity slice, generator law, package, null direction, owner,
  reservoir member, coefficient, scale or rate. No exclusion, injectivity,
  packet completion, witness, checkpoint, Python, network or official run is
  produced by contract correction alone.
D2SW10_S1_DECISION_AND_CORRECTED_CONTRACT_DELTA_BODY_END
```

```text
D2SW10_BOUNDED_PK1_WHOLE_MAP_KERNEL_CALCULATION_BODY_BEGIN
PRECEDENCE_AND_SCOPE:
  The effective task557+task560+task563 contract passed task564 static math
  and task565 physics/identity audits. This calculation uses only accepted
  contract295/295R1, task539/task542, task547 and corrected task552 evidence.
  It evaluates KT1-KT6 analytically. It adds no state, law, dimension, field,
  scale, fit, owner, current, reservoir assignment or run.

KT1_ACCEPTED_STATE_ALPHABET_ENUMERATION:
  Contract295 explicitly contains a finite fixed-incidence G_loc, existing
  capacity_loc and physical contact geometry_loc, plus the prepared-interface
  geometry Sigma_prep=[S_prep,q_ab,n,boundary(S_prep)]_rel. Task547 therefore
  recognizes only these relevant physical direction families:
    I3 interface embedding/induced/extrinsic geometry,
    I4 fixed-graph bond capacity,
    I5 fixed-graph bond anisotropy/geometry,
    I7 combinations forced by an existing constraint.
  The corresponding task557 test sets V_cap and V_geom are definitions of
  admissible membership conditions only. Accepted evidence does not prove
  their dimension, nontriviality, independence, complementarity, coverage of
  Q_Z or a complete list of mixed physical quotient directions.

KT2_CAPACITY_TO_MATERIAL_GENERATOR_LAW_SEARCH:
  Task542 supplies the existing linear quotient-covariant generator notation
    Xi_Z(deltaZ)=xi[deltaZ]
  and task552 defines the quotient restriction X_Z=Xi_Z|Q_Z. Contract295
  records capacities and geometry but supplies no unique quotient-covariant
  law mapping every capacity or geometry variation to the material generator,
  no matrix of assembled X_Z on a complete quotient basis, and no exact
  constraint with tangent derivative proving V_cap={0}. No accepted
  descendant supplies the missing law. The law search result is therefore
    CAPACITY_TO_MATERIAL_GENERATOR_LAW: NOT_ESTABLISHED_IN_ACCEPTED_CORPUS.

KT3_WHOLE_KERNEL_AND_EQUIVALENT_THEOREM_TEST:
  Accepted task552 states that the current corpus has no proved-complete Q_Z
  packet. Therefore G0 applies before any kernel calculation:
    Q_Z_COMPLETENESS: UNPROVED;
    K_all=ker(X_Z): NOT_CLASSIFIABLE;
    K_cap and K_geom: NOT_EVALUATED;
    whole-map injectivity: NOT_PROVED;
    nonzero whole-map kernel witness: NOT_PROVED.
  For the equivalent sector route, W1 is absent because no complete domain
  decomposition or overlap-resolved spanning cover is proved. W2 cannot be
  established without the restricted maps; W3 image independence/no-cross-
  sector-cancellation is absent; hence W4 cannot infer assembled injectivity.
  T0 and T3 are unresolved. T1 is present only as named candidate direction
  families, not member-by-member complete lineage. T2 provides the abstract
  linear covariant map but not its complete assembled evaluation. T4 remains
  a guard and is not violated by this calculation.

KT4_EXCLUSION_BRANCH:
  No nonzero physical member of K_all is established. PK1 cannot be excluded
  on the capacity, geometry, mixed or whole-map kernel branch. Absence of a
  witness is not evidence that K_all={0}.
```

```text
DECLARED_EXISTING_SCOPE:
  Work on one fixed-incidence regular pre-event parent-cell stratum in the
  accepted Landau domain. The state remains exactly
    Z_rec=[B_rec,Sigma_prep]_rel,
    B_rec=[G_loc,capacity_loc,geometry_loc]_rel,
    Sigma_prep=[S_prep,q_ab,n^mu,boundary(S_prep)]_rel.
  The quotient removes only accepted relabelings, coordinate changes and
  representation changes preserving incidence, capacity and physical
  geometry. It may not erase a physically distinct capacity, geometry,
  connectivity or prepared-interface variation. Fixed incidence means no
  topology change. Every result is conditional on the already accepted
  Type-I, unique nondegenerate future Landau direction, smoothness,
  causality, owner/worldtube and source-off guards.

N1_COMPLETE_QUOTIENT_CONSTRUCTION_OBLIGATION:
  Let V_raw(Z) be the tangent of the full accepted state record before the
  _rel quotient, subject to the differentiated incidence, capacity-domain,
  contact-geometry, induced-metric, unit-normal, interface-boundary,
  orientation, Landau-regularity and every other accepted same-member
  constraint. Derived entries q_ab, n^mu and boundary(S_prep) must be varied
  through their defining geometry; they are not independent duplicate
  directions. Let V_rel(Z) be exactly the infinitesimal coordinate and
  reparametrization vertical directions; a discrete relabeling has no new
  tangent direction on a fixed-incidence stratum. Define
    Q_Z=V_raw(Z)/V_rel(Z).
  N1 passes only with a completeness certificate listing every primitive
  state direction, every differentiated constraint and every overlap or
  derived-variable identification, and proving that V_rel contains only
  representation changes. Named capacity/interface/geometry families or a
  formal quotient symbol are not such a certificate.

  If the accepted corpus does not uniquely determine that certificate, do
  not choose a gauge slice or silently omit directions. Retain instead the
  complete outer family
    A_Q(Z)={Q_Z^alpha: alpha is a completion using only the accepted state
            alphabet, all accepted constraints and exactly the _rel gauge}.
  A_Q is an FS-GATE-02 range object. Its nonemptiness requires at least one
  explicit completion or an existence theorem; a list of conditions alone
  remains RANGE_CONDITIONAL_OPEN.

N2_ASSEMBLED_WHOLE_MAP_OBLIGATION:
  For each certified Q in A_Q(Z), assemble the existing material-generator
  map on the whole quotient,
    X_Z=Xi_Z|Q_Z:Q_Z -> Gamma(TW_pc),
    Xi_Z(deltaZ)=xi[deltaZ].
  Assembly means one quotient-consistent graph assigning the generator to
  every primitive and mixed physical direction, with overlaps identified
  before summation. Separate capacity, interface or geometry restrictions
  are diagnostics only. A member must preserve linearity on the declared
  tangent, locality/local naturality, covariance, units, causal support,
  smoothness and the accepted material-generator provenance. It must vanish
  on V_rel and descend to Q_Z. No arbitrary basis embedding, null direction,
  minimum-norm extension or fitted scale is allowed.

  If existing physics fixes only constraints on X_Z and not one complete
  graph, retain the operator family
    A_X(Z,Q)={X:Q->Gamma(TW_pc) satisfying all of the above exact guards and
              every already accepted generator identity}.
  Missing graph values are unknown, not zero. A_X is not proved nonempty by
  its definition; one sourced member or an existence theorem is required.
  The already existing but unresolved map receives the persistent identifier
    UF-C01-RW1-XI-002.

N3_WHOLE_KERNEL_OR_INJECTIVITY_RANGE:
  Only for certified Q and sourced X define K_all(X)=ker(X) on the whole Q.
  Preserve the complete set-valued discriminator
    A_K(Z)={(Q,X,K_all(X)):Q in A_Q(Z), X in A_X(Z,Q)}.
  In a finite exact presentation record the entire allowed nullity set
    N_adm(Z)={dim ker(X):(Q,X,K_all) in A_K(Z)};
  otherwise record the exact alternatives K_all={0} and K_all!={0} with
  their proven domains. Do not average, rank by preference or select one
  map. Sectorwise W1-W4 may replace direct whole-map analysis only when W1
  gives a complete overlap-resolved domain, W2 proves every restriction
  injective, W3 proves independent images/no cross-sector cancellation and
  W4 derives injectivity of the assembled map.

EXHAUSTIVE_DECISION_BRANCHES:
  N1_WAITING:
    no complete Q certificate and no proved member of A_Q; report the first
    missing primitive, constraint or overlap rule. No kernel inference.
  N2_WAITING:
    a complete Q is available but no sourced assembled X member or existence
    theorem; report the first missing generator action. Missing action is
    not zero and formal A_X conditions are not an existence result.
  N3_RANGE_MIXED_LIVE_WAITING:
    certified allowed members include both injective and noninjective
    possibilities, or the actual member is not selected by existing physics;
    preserve the whole range and the unresolved-function identifier.
  PK1_I0_KERNEL_EXCLUDED_EXACT_SCOPE:
    one certified existing-scope member has a nonzero physical K_all witness;
    PK1 alone is excluded on that declared scope, subject to result audits.
  PK1_I0_WHOLE_MAP_INJECTIVE_SCOPE:
    the actual sourced whole X is injective directly or by complete W1-W4;
    only then may a later contract evaluate fixed E_N and downstream gates.
  MATERIAL_FINDING:
    classify P0/T1/S1-S4, quarantine affected reach when required and return
    to the earliest valid point. No automatic parent-track closure.

BOUNDED_ANALYTIC_CALCULATION_AFTER_DUAL_CONTRACT_PASS:
  AQ1 enumerate the accepted primitive/derived state directions and all
      explicit differentiated constraints on the declared fixed stratum;
  AQ2 construct or fail-closed classify A_Q with overlaps and gauge resolved;
  AX1 collect every accepted equation fixing Xi_Z on those directions;
  AX2 assemble one sourced whole X or construct the exact allowed family A_X;
  AK1 compute the whole-map kernel/nullity range only where Q and X are
      certified, including cross-sector cancellation;
  AK2 return exactly one exhaustive decision branch and the smallest missing
      physical input. Evaluate neither E_N nor owner/power/reservoir gates.

DONE_WHEN:
  The bounded result provides either a certified complete Q plus an actual
  whole-map kernel/injectivity result, or the exact nonselected allowed
  Q/X/kernel range with persistent unresolved-function lineage and the first
  missing physical datum. Conditional openness is real boundary progress but
  is not RANGE_EXISTENCE_PASS, PK1 selection, or theory closure.

NONCLAIMS:
  This contract adds no field, state component, interaction topology, causal
  rule, owner, current, reservoir channel, energy scale, coefficient, rate,
  fit, observational tolerance or hidden clock. It does not assert that A_Q,
  A_X or A_K is nonempty; that Q_Z is finite dimensional; that Xi_Z is zero,
  unique or injective; or that any package survives or is excluded. It does
  not authorize Python, network access, DEV, RC, official execution,
  checkpoint creation, external audit, score/depth change or closure of
  C01-RW1, P5 or A2-K4.
```

```text
NOTATION_DISAMBIGUATION:
  Accepted result300 uses X_Z:M_pc->M for the material embedding, while the
  D2SW9-D2SW11 kernel contracts use X_Z=Xi_Z|Q_Z for the whole material-
  generator operator. This result writes X_emb,Z for the former and X_gen,Z

AQ1_ACCEPTED_PRIMITIVE_AND_DERIVED_DIRECTION_ENUMERATION:
  On fixed incidence the finite graph G_loc=(V_loc,E_loc) has no continuous
  edge-creation, deletion or rewiring tangent. The accepted corpus names the
  following possible primitive physical direction families:
    P1 delta-capacity_loc on already existing contacts, subject to the
       unspecified accepted capacity domains and shared-contact identities;
    P2 delta-geometry_loc of the existing parent/contact material regions and
       their embeddings/orientations, with topology and incidence fixed;
    P3 delta-S_prep, the embedding/deformation and physical front of the
       already existing prepared-interface complex.
  These are family names, not a proved basis or direct sum. The contact
  geometry occurring in B_rec and the prepared-interface geometry can share
  physical face/front data, so their overlap cannot be counted twice.

  The following entries are derived and are not independent directions:
    D1 delta-q_ab is the differentiated induced metric of S_prep;
    D2 delta-n^mu obeys n.n=1, u_cell.n=0 and the differentiated embedding/
       orientation relations;
    D3 delta-boundary(S_prep) is the boundary trace induced by delta-S_prep;
    D4 delta-u_cell is fixed, where defined, by differentiating the simple
       Type-I Landau eigenproblem, unit normalization and future orientation;
    D5 delta-h_cell, delta-h_rec and delta-dV_rec follow from
       h_cell=g+u_cell tensor u_cell and h_rec=X_emb,Z^*h_cell on M_pc;
    D6 delta-T_loc, delta-Pi_CT, delta-T_CT and delta-j_CT are derivatives of
       their accepted state-functionals where those maps are defined.
  Treating D1-D6 as new independent coordinates would duplicate state.

  The explicit exact tangent restrictions found in the accepted corpus are:
    C1 fixed incidence and fixed topological type of G_loc, M_pc and S_prep;
    C2 differentiated capacity-domain and shared-contact compatibility;
    C3 induced-metric, unit-normal, orthogonality, interface-boundary,
       orientation and embedding compatibility;
    C4 restriction to open regular branches where T_loc[Z] and the simple
       future Landau eigenspace are smooth;
    C5 quotient only by local coordinate changes, face/material
       reparametrizations and representation relabels preserving incidence,
       capacity and physical geometry. Discrete relabeling contributes no
       continuous tangent on this stratum.
  Physical capacity, geometry, connectivity or interface changes may not be
  placed in the vertical subspace.

AQ1_COMPLETENESS_TEST:
  The corpus does not specify the component manifold/fiber and local chart of
  capacity_loc, geometry_loc or S_prep; the exact contact-to-interface overlap
  and gluing maps; a complete differentiated constraint operator for C1-C4;
  or a proved exhaustive vertical space V_rel. Therefore P1-P3 cannot be
  promoted to a dimensioned basis, spanning cover or complete quotient
  tangent. Standard graph and submanifold geometry supplies the form of C1-C5
  and D1-D6, but it cannot determine these theory-specific state fibers and
  identifications without adding unrecorded physical structure.

AQ2_ALLOWED_QUOTIENT_RANGE:
  The only exact current object is the unselected conditional family
    A_Q(Z)={V_raw^alpha(Z)/V_rel^alpha(Z): alpha completes P1-P3, D1-D6,
            C1-C5 using only accepted state data and no physical quotienting}.
  No explicit alpha member and no existence/completeness theorem occurs in
  the accepted corpus. Hence
    A_Q_MEMBER_PROVED: false,
    A_Q_NONEMPTY_PROVED: false,
    COMPLETE_Q_Z_CERTIFICATE: false,
    AQ2_STATE: RANGE_CONDITIONAL_OPEN.
  This is not an empty-set certificate.

AX1_ACCEPTED_MATERIAL_GENERATOR_EQUATION_CATALOGUE:
  The accepted equations constrain, but do not assemble, the generator:
    X_gen,Z(deltaZ)=Xi_Z(deltaZ)=xi[deltaZ], linear and quotient-covariant;
    xi[deltaZ]=N[deltaZ]u_cell+v[deltaZ], u_cell.v[deltaZ]=0;
    delta-h_rec,AB=2D_(A xi_B) on a tangent already possessing a unique
      material generator;
    K_N[deltaZ]=i_(T_CT.xi[deltaZ])epsilon_g and
    dK_N=[Q_CT.xi[deltaZ]+(1/2)T_CT:L_(xi[deltaZ])g]epsilon_g;
    boundary traction/current forms are linear evaluations of the same xi.
  The last two lines map a supplied xi into work/current data; they do not
  invert for xi. The strain identity has no accepted inversion, boundary
  conditions or uniqueness theorem, and it does not determine the action of
  Xi_Z on a capacity-only or general mixed physical variation. No accepted
  equation assigns generator values to every P1-P3/overlap-resolved direction.

AX2_WHOLE_MAP_ALLOWED_RANGE:
  Because no Q in A_Q is certified, X_gen,Z cannot be assembled on a complete
  domain. Even conditionally, the corpus provides neither a uniquely sourced
  X_actual nor a proved-nonempty P1-P2-complete family containing every
  physically possible actual law. The formal A_X(Z,Q) therefore remains a
  well-typed conditional constraint set only:
    A_X_MEMBER_PROVED: false,
    A_X_NONEMPTY_PROVED: false,
    X_ACTUAL_IDENTIFIED: false,
    P1_P2_COMPLETE_FAMILY_PROVED: false,
    UNRESOLVED_FUNCTION_ID: UF-C01-RW1-XI-002.
  Missing generator action is unknown and is not set to zero.

AK1_WHOLE_KERNEL_AND_NULLITY_RANGE:
  Task570 permits K_all(X)=ker(X) only for certified Q and sourced X. Neither
  exists here, so A_K cannot be instantiated and no nullity set N_adm is
  defined. Whole-map injectivity, a nonzero physical kernel witness, mixed
  family status and W1-W4 image independence all remain unproved. The logical
  alternatives ker(X)={0} and ker(X)!={0} are both unexcluded, but neither is
  promoted to a physical member or a proved domain. No sector restriction is
  substituted for the whole map.

AK2_PROOF_EXHAUSTIVE_DECISION_AND_SMALLEST_INPUT:
  The first effective branch is exactly N1_WAITING: there is no complete Q
  certificate and no proved member of A_Q. N2 and all task576 N3 kernel-
  classification branches are not reached. E_N, owner, active-power and
  reservoir gates are not evaluated.

  The smallest reactivation packet is one existing regular Z with:
    R1 an exact primitive manifold/fiber chart for every capacity_loc,
       existing contact/material geometry and S_prep degree of freedom;
    R2 the exact contact-geometry/S_prep overlap and gluing maps;
    R3 all differentiated capacity, embedding, induced-metric, normal,
       boundary, orientation and Landau-regularity constraints;
    R4 a proved exhaustive V_rel containing only representation directions;
    R5 a proof that the resulting quotient spans every physical mixed
       direction without double counting.
  R1-R5 define existing state provenance; they may not introduce a new field,
  topology, scale or hidden clock. Only after N1 passes may a later bounded
  step request the sourced whole Xi_Z action on that same quotient.
```

```text
  pre-event parent-cell state Z with fixed graph incidence and topology.
  For each existing contact e, capacity_loc is one nonnegative scalar c_e.

  geometry_loc is the fixed-incidence material contact geometry. A shared
  contact face and Sigma_prep are one physical primitive, not two independent
  directions. Sigma_prep is a smooth oriented codimension-one embedded
  interface of fixed topology; its induced metric, unit normal and boundary
  are derived. Gauge contains only coordinate changes, reparametrizations and
  representation relabels that preserve the complete physical state.

  overlap-resolved, representation-quotiented physical tangent Q_Z from the
  authorized primitives. If Q_Z is complete, test whether accepted equations
  source the whole quotient-covariant material-generator action
  X_gen,Z=Xi_Z|Q_Z. Only if that whole action is sourced may the effective
  task570+task573+task576 N3 kernel branches be reached. DONE_WHEN returns the
  earliest exact state among R1_REGULAR_WAITING, N1_COMPLETE_TRIVIAL_WAITING,
  N1_COMPLETE_NONTRIVIAL_PASS_N2_WAITING, N2_WHOLE_MAP_PASS_N3_CLASSIFICATION,
  or an exact scoped actual/universal N3 verdict. No E_N or downstream gate.

R0_FIXED_DOMAIN:
  G_loc=(V_loc,E_loc) is the accepted finite pre-event local binding graph.
  Edge creation, deletion, rewiring and topology change have no tangent in
  this atom. Z is in the accepted Type-I unique-future-Landau regular domain.
  Each capacity lies in a fixed smooth regular stratum C_e^reg of the allowed
  subset of [0,infinity) selected by the existing geometry/passivity/
  conservation guards. C_e^reg may be positive-dimensional or an isolated
  point; no lower/upper value is fitted. If the actual Z is not in a smooth
  fixed-active-set stratum, return R1_REGULAR_WAITING rather than clamp it.

R1_PRIMITIVE_STATE_FIBER:
  Let M_a be the existing parent/contact material regions and let Sigma be the
  fixed abstract interface manifold. Primitive data are
    C(Z)=product over e in E_loc of C_e^reg,
    X_a:M_a -> M for the existing fixed-incidence material geometry,
    X_Sigma:Sigma -> M for the oriented prepared-interface embedding.
  For every shared contact face F_e subset boundary(M_parent), the fixed
  incidence supplies a gluing identification i_e:F_e -> Sigma_e subset Sigma
  and the physical state obeys
    X_parent restricted to F_e = X_Sigma composed with i_e.
  This fiber-product equality makes the shared face one primitive. It is not
  copied into an independent contact-face plus interface-face coordinate.

R2_DERIVED_OBJECTS_AND_LINEARIZED_CONSTRAINTS:
  q=X_Sigma^* g. The accepted orientation, n.n=1 and n tangent-orthogonality
  select n; boundary(Sigma_prep) is the trace of X_Sigma on boundary(Sigma).
  u_cell is rederived from the simple Type-I Landau eigenproblem. h_cell,
  h_rec, dV_rec, T_loc, Pi_CT, T_CT and j_CT remain existing state functionals.
  Their variations are derivatives of the primitive state and are never added
  as independent directions. The raw tangent T_raw(Z) is the fiber product of
  direct-sum capacity tangents T_c_e C_e^reg and embedding tangents satisfying
  the differentiated gluing, fixed-incidence, fixed-topology, orientation,
  induced-metric, normal, boundary, Landau, passivity and conservation
  constraints. Regularity means these accepted constraints have locally
  constant rank on the selected stratum; otherwise R1_REGULAR_WAITING.

R3_REPRESENTATION_ONLY_VERTICAL_SPACE:
  V_rel(Z) is exactly the image of infinitesimal coordinate changes and
  reparametrizations of M_a and Sigma, together with continuous
  representation relabels that leave every physical capacity, incidence,
  embedded material region, shared face and interface geometry unchanged.
  Discrete relabels have zero continuous tangent. A capacity change, normal
  interface deformation, physical contact deformation, connectivity change
  or change of shared-face identification is never vertical. The candidate
  quotient is
    Q_Z = T_raw(Z) / V_rel(Z).

R4_COMPLETENESS_AND_NO_DOUBLE_COUNT_OBLIGATION:
  Prove both directions on the authorized regular stratum:
    (a) every differentiable physical state curve with the fixed ontology
        yields one class in Q_Z;
    (b) every member of T_raw integrates locally to such a curve, modulo
        V_rel, using the regular constant-rank/implicit-function condition.
  The fiber-product gluing must prove that shared face/interface variations
  occur once. Mixed capacity-geometry-interface variations must remain unless
  an accepted linearized constraint removes them. No direct-sum assumption,
  sector substitution or physical quotienting is allowed.

R5_NONTRIVIALITY_BRANCH:
  The zero class proves set nonemptiness but not a physical transport degree.
  Q_Z is nontrivial only if at least one nonzero allowed capacity, material-
  geometry, normal-interface or mixed tangent class survives all constraints
  and V_rel. If completeness holds but Q_Z={0}, return
  N1_COMPLETE_TRIVIAL_WAITING and do not infer a useful injectivity or PK1
  verdict from the zero-domain map.

X1_WHOLE_GENERATOR_SOURCE_TEST:
  After nontrivial N1 PASS, catalogue the accepted action of Xi_Z on every
  quotient direction, including capacity-only and all overlap-resolved mixed
  directions. Geometry/strain, Noether-Cartan and traction/current equations
  may be used only in their accepted direction. A supplied material generator
  may be evaluated by those equations, but an evaluation identity is not an
  inversion or uniqueness law. Missing capacity action may not be set to zero.
  Sector maps do not assemble the whole map unless overlap compatibility and
  image independence/no-cross-cancellation are proved.

K1_KERNEL_REACH_GUARD:
  Reach N3 only if one actual whole quotient-covariant X_gen,Z is uniquely
  sourced, or if a proved-nonempty complete P1/P2 family satisfying effective
  task573 guards is sourced. Then apply effective task570+task573+task576
  branches, including kernel-classification WAITING and no vacuous universal
  claim. Infinite-dimensional zero/nonzero kernel typing and W1-W4 remain as
  accepted. Otherwise return N2_WHOLE_MAP_LIVE_WAITING with the exact missing
  primitive action; do not evaluate E_N, owner, power or reservoir.

DECISION_ORDER:
  1. domain/regularity and fixed-active-stratum gate;
  2. R1-R4 complete fiber-product quotient proof;
  3. R5 physical nontriviality;
  4. whole-map source/descent/overlap test;
  5. effective N3 branch only if 1-4 pass;
  6. E_N and every downstream owner/power/reservoir gate are unreachable in
     this atom.

NONCLAIMS_AND_FORBIDDEN_RESCUES:
  The contract adds no field, state component, interaction edge, topology,
  causal rule, clock, scale, energy fit, owner, reset, null direction or
  observational input. It does not identify u_cell with a plasma frame, does
  not choose K_bridge, does not infer a missing Xi action is zero, and does not
  close C01-RW1, P5 or A2-K4. Failure returns LIVE/WAITING with an exact input.
```

```text
CURRENT_PHASE: D2SW13_TASK601_CONTRACT_FROZEN_PENDING_EXACT_BODY_HASH_ADOPTION

D2SW13_SAME_Z_CERTIFICATE_ONLY_CONTRACT_BODY_BEGIN
PRECEDENCE_AND_SCOPE:
  Accepted task596 and effective task583+task586+task589+task593 are immutable
  inputs. This atom uses the same one regular pre-event parent-cell state Z,
  the same fixed graph incidence and topology, scalar existing-contact
  capacities c_e, fixed-incidence material embeddings and the single shared
  contact/Sigma_prep primitive. It asks only whether Q_Z is certified zero or
  contains one explicit full-constraint nonvertical class. It does not reach
  Xi_Z, A_X, A_K, a kernel, I0/PK1, E_N or any downstream gate.

QUESTION_AND_DONE_WHEN:
  Search existing accepted physics, in the fixed order C1-C3 below, for one
  exact tangent deltaZ in T_raw(Z)\V_rel(Z). Return exactly one of:
    NZ_CERT: one explicit nonvertical deltaZ with complete provenance;
    Z0_CERT: a proof that T_raw(Z) is contained in V_rel(Z);
    N1_CERTIFICATE_DATA_WAITING: neither certificate is proved, with the first
      exact missing state-local datum or linearized constraint map named.
  A conceivable deformation, an unnamed interval or failure to find a vector
  is never a certificate.

FIXED_TANGENT_TYPE:
  Write a candidate only as
    deltaZ=( {delta c_e}, {V_a}, V_Sigma ),
  where delta c_e belongs to T_c_e C_e^reg, V_a is a material/contact
  embedding tangent and V_Sigma is the one prepared-interface embedding
  tangent. Variations of q, n, boundary trace, u_cell, projectors, volume,
  stress and current are derived by differentiation and are not new entries.

FULL_CONSTRAINT_CERTIFICATE_F0_F7:
  F0 the actual Z remains on the same smooth fixed-active-set Type-I unique-
     Landau regular stratum;
  F1 every delta c_e has exact membership in T_c_e C_e^reg, including whether
     that tangent is zero or nonzero; nonnegativity alone does not decide it;
  F2 fixed incidence/topology hold and differentiated shared-face gluing holds
     once: V_parent|F_e = V_Sigma composed with i_e for fixed i_e;
  F3 orientation, induced metric, normal and boundary variations are the exact
     derivatives of the single shared primitive;
  F4 the complete accepted differentiated passivity and conservation maps
     annihilate deltaZ, not merely selected sector equations;
  F5 the differentiated simple Landau eigenproblem and all accepted regularity
     guards hold;
  F6 deltaZ is not in V_rel: prove no coordinate/reparametrization/state-
     preserving relabel generator produces it. A certified nonzero capacity
     change is sufficient for nonverticality; for a shape candidate, exhibit
     a nonzero physical normal/relative-geometry invariant not removable by
     representation change;
  F7 gluing counts the shared contact/Sigma_prep face once and mixed variations
     are retained unless the full constraint differential removes them.

ORDERED_EXISTING_PHYSICS_CANDIDATES:
  C1_CAPACITY:
    Seek one existing contact e with a proved positive-dimensional regular
    capacity stratum and a nonzero delta c_e. Set no other component by
    convention. Complete it to deltaZ only if the exact full F2-F5 linearized
    equations provide the required material/interface components. An
    unspecified allowed range or c_e>=0 is insufficient.
  C2_SHARED_INTERFACE_SHAPE:
    Seek a smooth nonzero normal variation of the one shared contact/interface
    primitive, with the identical matched parent-face variation required by
    F2. It is an NZ candidate only if fixed topology/orientation and every
    F3-F5 constraint are proved and F6 supplies a physical invariant. A free
    test function, rigid coordinate motion or interface-only displacement is
    insufficient.
  C3_MIXED_COMPENSATION:
    If accepted conservation/passivity couples capacity and shape, solve the
    exact homogeneous full linearized system for a nonzero tuple using only
    existing c_e and embeddings. No minimum-norm choice, fit, new multiplier,
    reservoir channel, owner rule or null-direction convention is allowed.

ZERO_CERTIFICATE_GUARD:
  Z0_CERT requires an exhaustive proof that every solution of the full F0-F5
  linearized system is generated by V_rel. Proving only that C1, C2 or a finite
  ansatz list fails is not Z0_CERT.

BOUNDED_MANUAL_CALCULATION_AFTER_DUAL_CONTRACT_PASS:
  NC1 inventory the exact accepted state-local capacity strata and full
      differentiated constraint maps for the same Z;
  NC2 test C1, then C2, then C3 without assuming absent maps are zero;
  NC3 verify F0-F7 for the first candidate that can be written exactly;
  NC4 otherwise return N1_CERTIFICATE_DATA_WAITING naming the earliest missing
      capacity tangent, shape invariant or full constraint differential;
  NC5 do not evaluate Xi_Z or any later quantity.

NONCLAIMS_AND_TRACK_IDENTITY:
  This contract adds no field, state component, edge, topology, causal rule,
  scale, fit, clock, owner, reset, reservoir variable or observational input.
  It does not select a capacity value or interface profile. WAITING leaves
  C01-RW1, P5 and A2-K4 LIVE/WAITING and preserves every accepted upstream
  result. A change of carrier or ontology requires a new Martin decision.
D2SW13_SAME_Z_CERTIFICATE_ONLY_CONTRACT_BODY_END
```

```text
PRECEDENCE_AND_SCOPE:
  Task606A authorizes exactly this one manual same-Z search. The effective
  immutable contract is task601 plus task604. Accepted task596 supplies the
  complete structural quotient on the same regular Z; task583 and accepted
  upstream supply only existing scalar contact capacities, fixed-incidence
  material/contact embeddings and the one shared contact/Sigma_prep primitive.
  No Python, network, official run, new state, field, scale, fit or downstream
  Xi/kernel/E_N object is used.

NC1_EXACT_STATE_LOCAL_INVENTORY:
  The corpus proves that every existing contact has one c_e in a smooth regular
  stratum C_e^reg subset [0,infinity), but task583 expressly permits that
  stratum to be positive-dimensional or an isolated point. No accepted record
  gives, for the actual c_e at this Z, an endpoint/range chart or a tangent
  certificate deciding whether T_c_e C_e^reg is zero or contains a nonzero
  delta c_e. Nonnegativity alone supplies only a set boundary, not membership
  of a signed tangent at the actual state.

  The complete raw tangent is structurally the kernel of differentiated
  gluing, fixed-topology, orientation, induced-geometry, Landau, passivity and
  conservation constraints. The accepted corpus does not provide the actual
  state-local full differential D C_Z, its coefficients on capacity and
  embedding variations, or a hash-bound one-parameter physical state curve
  whose derivative supplies those values. Thus the structural kernel is
  defined but cannot be populated or proved vertical from current data.

NC2_C1_CAPACITY_TEST:
  NOT_CERTIFIED. A nonzero delta c_e cannot be asserted because exact
  membership in T_c_e C_e^reg is absent. The calculation does not choose an
  interior point, infer a two-sided tangent from c_e>=0, or set compensating
  material/interface components to zero. F1 and the full F4 constraint test
  therefore remain unevaluated for every C1 member.

NC2_C2_SHARED_INTERFACE_SHAPE_TEST:
  Standard shape geometry supplies only the formal candidate
    delta c_e=0,
    V_Sigma=phi n with smooth nonzero phi,
    V_parent restricted to F_e=V_Sigma composed with i_e.
  This respects the one-face gluing form and makes q, n and the boundary trace
  derived. It is not an NZ certificate: the corpus does not supply the actual
  full passivity/conservation/Landau differential on this candidate, nor one
  physical relative-geometry invariant proving that the chosen phi is outside
  the complete state-preserving coordinate/reparametrization image. A free
  test function or normal-looking coordinate displacement cannot fill F4-F6.

NC2_C3_MIXED_COMPENSATION_TEST:
  NOT_SOLVABLE_FROM_CURRENT_DATA. A mixed tuple would have to solve
    D C_Z( {delta c_e}, {V_a}, V_Sigma )=0
  with differentiated gluing and then pass F6. Neither the capacity tangent
  domains nor the complete operator D C_Z are given, so its nullspace cannot
  be computed. No minimum-norm choice, new multiplier, reservoir channel or
  selected null direction is introduced.

NC3_F0_F7_CERTIFICATE_CHECK:
  No candidate reaches a complete F0-F7 packet. C1 stops at F1/F4; C2 stops at
  F4-F6; C3 stops before an exact member can be written. These failures are
  missing-data classifications and do not prove the absence of physical
  capacity, interface or mixed directions.

NC4_CORRECTED_PROOF_STATUS_DECISION:
  Z0_proved=false: no exhaustive proof establishes T_raw subseteq V_rel.
  NZ_proved=false: no explicit deltaZ in T_raw setminus V_rel has F0-F7.
  The both-proved inconsistency branch is false. Effective task604 branch 4
  therefore returns
    N1_CERTIFICATE_DATA_WAITING.

NC5_NONREACH_AND_REACTIVATION:
  Xi_Z, A_X, A_K, kernel, I0/PK1, E_N, owner, power, source-off and reservoir
  remain NOT_REACHED. The earliest missing state-local input is
    CAPACITY_AND_FULL_CONSTRAINT_TANGENT_CERTIFICATE_FOR_SAME_Z:
  either (a) for at least one existing contact, the actual C_e^reg chart/range
  and derivatives of every geometry/passivity/conservation guard, or (b) one
  hash-bound differentiable same-ontology state curve Z(s) through Z whose
  derivative explicitly provides capacity, matched shared-face/interface and
  all full-constraint components plus a nonvertical invariant. Without one of
  these existing-state provenance packets, further certificate search would
  repeat the same unknown function rather than calculate it.

BOUNDED_RESULT:
  RESULT_STATE: N1_CERTIFICATE_DATA_WAITING
  C1_CAPACITY_STATUS: WAITING_EXACT_T_C_E_REG_AND_FULL_CONSTRAINT_DIFFERENTIAL

    same-Z capacity tangent/full differentiated constraint provenance; a
    normal-interface ansatz alone is now explicitly separated from a physical
```

## D2SW14 — task614 bounded manual CR1–CR5 capacity-response curve result

```text
D2SW14_TASK614_CAPACITY_RESPONSE_CURVE_RESULT_BODY_BEGIN
SCOPE_AND_EXECUTION:
  Exactly one manual analytic CR1-CR5 screen was performed under immutable
  task611 plus task611B. No Python, project code, network, DEV, RC, official
  run, numerical fit or source acquisition was used. The task tests whether
  the current accepted corpus instantiates one actual same-Z response curve;
  it may return WAITING but may not manufacture missing state data.

CR1_ACTUAL_CONTACT_AND_BASE_STATE_INVENTORY:
  The accepted theory supplies the abstract regular-state types Z,
  capacity_loc, T_loc[Z], one shared contact/Sigma_prep primitive, Landau
  derivation rules and the full oriented parent-worldtube chain type. It does
  not supply in task611 or its accepted upstream one identified actual contact
  e together with all of:
    c_e(Z), a proved regular chart/range C_e^reg, A_e(0), the complete
    F_e-to-Gamma_e-to-C_W embedding and lift, the owner/orientation receipt,
    and the evaluated T_loc/current/geometry jets on a neighbourhood of Z.

  The most concrete accepted source candidate remains the Q1R6 scalar-plasma
  midpoint packet task535, SHA256
    0B6F5047E8FDEAB10A3FD1C7D44445C1EEF810F28B568489815E03C1C302E710.
  It fixes one source midpoint and a tensor-level convention dictionary, but
  its accepted result records: complete midpoint T_Q including T_out not
  evaluated; interface-to-Sigma_prep/worldtube map incomplete; pre-event
  owner absent; same-state conserved current unspecified; full I_7 and
  reservoir/constraint provenance absent. It also supplies no existing
  theory capacity coordinate c_e or C_e^reg chart. Therefore it is not an
  actual Z satisfying task611 G0-G8 and cannot be promoted by relabeling
  source wall thickness, plasma velocity or benchmark parameters.

  Existing exact outer bounds are only:
    A_e(0)>0 on any admissible area-parameter branch,
    s=ln(A_e/A_e(0)) dimensionless,
    c_e>=0 conditionally on the frozen passive orientation.
  No accepted datum yields a finite upper bound for c_e, a numerical A_e(0),
  an epsilon interval, or a base-value match. Thus [0,+infinity) is only a
  passivity outer range for the scalar coefficient, not its achieved image
  and not evidence that a curve exists.

  CR1_RESULT:
    WAITING / MISSING_ACTUAL_SAME_Z_CONTACT_CAPACITY_AND_FULL_JET_PACKET.

CR2_INDEPENDENT_RESPONSE_DERIVATIONS:
  On any future complete member the typed traction representation is fixed:
    R_T,e(s)=beta_T^CT[Z(s)](dZ/ds)
            =sum_(H in C_W[Z(s)]) integral_H
               T_CT^(mu nu)[Z(s)] xi_(s,nu) dSigma_mu.
  Its target-side spatial trace uses F_e,dA_q and V_e, while all caps, other
  sides, storage, moving-side, metric, embedding and corner terms remain in
  the full spacetime chain. This is a well-typed derivation template, not an
  evaluated response on an actual Z.

  Accepted result312 proves the Landau-current divergence and current Stokes
  identities and defines the current-transport first variation. It explicitly
  leaves the physical traction-current bridge open. Accepted contract313R1
  forbids defining the missing bridge by beta_T-beta_J and requires all
  pointwise geometry, Q_CT, stress-power, cap/storage, side and corner terms.
  The current corpus contains neither the complete actual jets needed to
  expand beta_J^CT on this curve nor a curve-local proof that
    R_T,e(s)=R_Jg,e(s)
  on an open interval. Consequently R_e and dR_e/ds are not defined on an
  actual member in this screen.

  CR2_RESULT:
    WAITING / MISSING_TYPED_CURVE_LOCAL_COMMON_RESPONSE.

CR3_COUPLED_LOCAL_CURVE_EXISTENCE:
  The permitted implicit system consists of the complete G0-G8 identities,
  the one-face gluing equalizer, differentiated Landau equations, full
  conservation/Noether/worldtube constraints and
    c_e[Z(s)]-dR_e(s)/ds=0.
  A local C2 solution would require a proved base solution and an applicable
  constant-rank/implicit-function certificate for the full coupled map on a
  fixed regular stratum. CR1 supplies no base member and CR2 supplies no
  common R_e; the full constraint Jacobian and its rank are also absent.
  Hence neither local existence nor nonexistence of the curve follows.

  CR3_RESULT:
    WAITING / MISSING_BASE_SOLUTION_COMMON_RESPONSE_AND_FULL_IMPLICIT_RANK.

CR4_PASSIVITY_BASE_MATCH_AND_NONVERTICALITY:
  Because no curve was certified, c_e>=0 cannot be checked against an actual
  c_e(Z), and no base-value match or interval passivity statement is proved.
  The identity
    I_A(s)=ln(A_e(s)/A_e(0))=s, dI_A/ds at 0 = 1
  is an exact conditional nonvertical invariant for any future full G0-G8
  curve, but task611 forbids using it before curve existence and actual-state
  matching. It therefore does not produce NZ_cert here.

  Failure to instantiate this one curve is not a universal proof that every
  full-constraint tangent is vertical. No exhaustive full tangent theorem is
  present, so it also does not produce Z0_cert.

  CR4_RESULT:
    NZ_PROVED=false; Z0_PROVED=false.

CR5_FAIL_CLOSED_PROOF_STATUS:
  Applying the effective task604 four-way order:
    both-proved=false;
    Z0-only=false;
    NZ-only=false;
    neither=true.
  The exact bounded result is therefore
    N1_CAPACITY_RESPONSE_CURVE_WAITING.
  The earliest stopping datum is CR1's missing actual same-Z contact,
  capacity/base chart and complete state-local jet packet. CR2's still-open
  common response and CR3's implicit-rank certificate are additional
  dependent requirements, not permission to bypass CR1.

EXACT_SMALLEST_REACTIVATION_PACKET:
  Freeze one existing regular Z and one existing contact e with one immutable
  provenance packet containing:
    1. contact identity, fixed incidence/topology, pre-event owner/orientation,
       F_e, Gamma_e, complete C_W and the unique full spacetime lift;
    2. A_e(0)>0 and a differentiable local shared-face geometry chart with
       exact first and second jets;
    3. actual c_e(Z) and C_e^reg range, or complete existing T_loc/current
       response data from which the base coefficient is derived and matched;
    4. evaluated T_loc/T_CT and same-state current plus every metric, normal,
       measure, embedding, Q_CT, stress-power, cap/storage, side and corner
       jet needed to derive R_T,e and R_Jg,e independently;
    5. all G0-G8 constraint maps and a full base-solution plus constant-rank
       certificate for the coupled implicit system.
  The already accepted Q1R6 midpoint may serve only if its task535 missing
  tensor, geometry-map, owner, current and full-state receipts are supplied
  from existing frozen evidence without digitisation, fit or new ontology.

SCIENTIFIC_REACH_AND_NONCLAIMS:
  This result localizes the exact data boundary and preserves the conditional
  passivity range. It proves neither existence nor nonexistence of the curve,
  neither NZ nor Z0, and no common traction-current response. It does not
  evaluate Xi_Z, A_X, A_K, a kernel, I0/PK1, E_N, owner/reservoir selection,
  dynamics, observable, checkpoint, score/depth change or parent closure.
  C01-RW1, P5 and A2-K4 remain LIVE/WAITING for the named packet.
D2SW14_TASK614_CAPACITY_RESPONSE_CURVE_RESULT_BODY_END
```

```text
D2SW15_TASK622_CONDITIONAL_CR1A_MAP_CONTRACT_BODY_BEGIN
AUTHOR_INPUT_AND_PRECEDENCE:
  Martin Jambor authorizes a conditional set-valued CR1a contract over every
  already existing regular contact for which both the unique pre-event B_rec
  causal orientation and the complete F_e -> Gamma_e -> C_W lift are proved.
  Nonemptiness is not assumed. WallGo version 1.0.0 is admitted only as an
  E2_REFERENCE_MODEL comparator; it is neither a source nor a supplement of
  Q1R6/arXiv:2204.13120. Effective task611+task611B, accepted task614+task618,
  task621A, contracts305/313R1, result312 and task535 remain immutable.

QUESTION_AND_DONE_WHEN:
  Freeze the exact conditional domain and the complete memberwise
  geometry-to-stress mapping obligation without choosing or inventing a
  member. DONE_WHEN distinguishes: no certified member; an incomplete member
  receipt; one complete typed member map; a contradictory receipt; and an E2
  reference mismatch. No branch may infer nonemptiness, emptiness, a common
  traction-current response, a same-Z curve, NZ/Z0 or any downstream gate.

CONDITIONAL_DOMAIN_AND_RECEIPT:
  Let D_CR1a be the set of triples (Z,e,R_e) such that:
    D0 Z is an already existing pre-event state in the fixed-incidence,
       fixed-topology, smooth Type-I unique-future-Landau regular domain;
    D1 e is an already existing shared contact with a named identity and
       complete incident-parent set I_Z(e) in the existing B_rec graph;
    D2 the quotient-invariant incoming signs epsilon_(p,e)[B_rec] in
       {-1,0,+1} are frozen and O_Z(e)={p in I_Z(e):epsilon_(p,e)=+1}
       has exactly one member p_*(e); the resulting weight is
       w_(p,e)=1_(p=p_*(e));
    D3 R_e contains the physical shared face F_e, its fixed gluing map
       i_e:F_e->Sigma_e subset Sigma_prep and the one-face equality
       X_parent|F_e=X_Sigma composed with i_e;
    D4 R_e contains the unique full spacetime lift xi_e of the admissible
       material/contact variation, the swept side Gamma_e generated from F_e,
       and the complete oriented worldtube three-chain
         C_W=Sigma_+-Sigma_-+sum_(p,c)w_(p,c)sigma_(p,c)Gamma_(p,c),
       including cap, side, boundary/corner, orientation and no-double-count
       receipts;
    D5 all objects descend under coordinate change, reparametrization and
       state-preserving relabeling, and use no new field, scale, topology,
       causal rule, owner, memory, reset or fit.
  D_CR1a may be empty, nonempty or epistemically undecided. This contract
  proves none of those alternatives and creates no placeholder member.

MEMBERWISE_GEOMETRY_TO_STRESS_MAP:
  For each certified (Z,e,R_e) in D_CR1a, derive only from existing objects:
    X_F,e:=X_parent|F_e=X_Sigma composed with i_e;
    q_e:=X_F,e^* h_cell, dA_e:=dA_(q_e), A_e:=integral_(F_e)dA_e;
    the inherited oriented unit spatial normal n_e with
      n_e.n_e=1 and u_cell.n_e=0;
    Gamma_e:=Sweep_(xi_e)(F_e) and the complete C_W receipt above;
    u_cell as the unique future Landau eigenvector of existing T_loc[Z];
    T_CT:=Pi_CT[T_loc]=P_E[T_loc]+P_nn[T_loc]+P_mix[T_loc];
    t_CT^mu:=h_cell^mu_alpha T_CT^(alpha nu)n_(e,nu)
             =S_nn n_e^mu+v^mu;
    j_CT^mu:=-T_CT^(mu nu)u_(cell,nu)=rho_L u_cell^mu.
  The conditional map M_CR1a sends a certified member to the tuple
    (q_e,dA_e,A_e,n_e,Gamma_e,C_W,u_cell,T_loc,T_CT,t_CT,j_CT,J_e),
  where J_e is the complete evaluated metric, normal, measure, embedding,
  source, Q_CT, stress-power, cap/storage, moving-side and corner jet receipt
  needed by task611B. J_e is not inferred from typing and missing entries are
  never set to zero.

MEMBER_GUARDS_M0_M8:
  M0 exact D0-D5 receipt and immutable provenance;
  M1 one physical F_e/Sigma_prep primitive and differentiated gluing, counted
     once with fixed incidence/topology;
  M2 Landau Type-I, uniqueness, future orientation, nondegeneracy and smooth
     differentiated eigenproblem;
  M3 unique binary owner, inherited sign and identical face weight in every
     cap, side, corner, traction and current term;
  M4 complete chain and boundary/corner identities with compatible form
     degree and orientation before integration;
  M5 T_loc source lineage and Pi_CT/t_CT/j_CT derivations, without identifying
     a macro tensor or comparator output with T_loc;
  M6 independent traction and current-plus-geometry derivation inputs on the
     same C_W; equality R_T,e=R_Jg,e is a later proof obligation, not a clause;
  M7 complete conservation/Noether/complement/source-off ledger with no silent
     zero, reservoir split or post-integral residual definition;
  M8 covariance, gauge/relabel descent, locality, units, passivity-domain and
     regularity jets required by effective task611+task611B G0-G8.

SET_VALUED_OUTPUT_AND_PROOF_STATUS:
  Define
    A_map(Z,e):={M_CR1a(Z,e,R_e): (Z,e,R_e) in D_CR1a and M0-M8 pass}.
  This is a memberwise conditional image, not a global section. No selected
  representative, midpoint, minimum-norm value, null direction or arbitrary
  completion is allowed. The proof-status order is fail-closed:
    P0 contradictory complete receipts for the same invariant state/contact
       -> MATERIAL_FINDING_INCONSISTENT_CR1A_RECEIPT; select neither;
    P1 no certified member and no applicable nonempty-domain theorem
       -> CR1A_DOMAIN_MEMBER_WAITING / RANGE_CONDITIONAL_OPEN;
    P2 named candidate but any D0-D5 or M0-M8 item absent, failed or
       underdetermined -> CR1A_MEMBER_MAP_WAITING, naming the first item;
    P3 one certified member with every M0-M8 item proved
       -> CR1A_MEMBER_GEOMETRY_TO_STRESS_MAP_TYPED for that member only;
    P4 WallGo-v1.0.0 comparison mismatch -> REFERENCE_MISMATCH_ONLY unless an
       independently mapped E0/E1 guard also fails in its own exact scope.
  P3 is not a common response, curve-existence, NZ/Z0 or physics PASS.

WALLGO_V1_0_0_E2_BOUNDARY:
  The comparator identity is fixed to WallGo version 1.0.0. No WallGo bytes,
  inputs or outputs are frozen in this atom and no code is executed. A future
  comparison requires a separately authorized immutable source/input receipt.
  WallGo may compare machine-readable model equations, benchmark conventions
  or implementation structure only. It cannot supply or overwrite T_loc,
  B_rec, contact identity, incidence, owner, lift, capacity, current, G0-G8,
  Q1R6 provenance or any missing jet. Agreement is E2 support only; mismatch
  alone neither kills nor confirms the CR1a member or parent track.

CURRENT_EVIDENCE_BOUNDARY_AND_SMALLEST_SUCCESSOR:
  Task621A establishes that the current corpus has no certified member of
  D_CR1a. Therefore the current applicable state remains P1, without a new
  calculation. The smallest reactivation packet is one immutable member
  receipt naming Z,e,I_Z(e), every epsilon_(p,e), unique p_*, F_e,i_e,
  Gamma_e,C_W,xi_e and the evaluated existing T_loc/current/geometry/source
  jets needed for M0-M8. If WallGo is actually compared, add its exact
  v1.0.0 byte/source/input receipt under a separate no-run or run permission.

NONCLAIMS_AND_TRACK_IDENTITY:
  The contract proves neither D_CR1a nonemptiness nor emptiness, no actual
  member map, common response, c_e value/range/image, local curve, NZ, Z0,
  global K_bridge, Xi, A_X, A_K, kernel, I0/PK1, E_N, owner or reservoir
  selection, dynamics, observable, checkpoint, score/depth change or closure.
  It adds no ontology. C01-RW1, P5 and A2-K4 remain LIVE/WAITING.
```

## AUTHORITATIVE EOF — task624 bounded four-point invariant contact-stencil manual result freeze

```text
TASK_ID: A2K4-B6B2-12-H-RDIV-C01-RW1-SW1-D2SW15-TASK624-FOUR-POINT-CONTACT-STENCIL-MANUAL-RESULT-20260813
TIMESTAMP_UTC: 2026-08-13T09:31:00Z
ROLE: main_orchestrator-manual-analytic-result-author
ROLE_CONFIG_SHA256: NOT_APPLICABLE_MAIN_ORCHESTRATOR

SEPARATION_OF_DUTIES_CHECK: task624-author-root_must-not-audit-own-result; fresh-independent-manual-auditor-required
MARTIN_AUTHORIZATION: approved-two-boundary-and-two-interior-states-of-the-same-contact_and_start-calculation_2026-08-13
ROUTE: A1_K1_A2_K4_P5.3_SM_v1_B6b-2.12_C01_RW1_SW1_D2SW15_CR1A_FOUR_POINT_STENCIL
CURRENT_PHASE: D2SW15_TASK624_FOUR_POINT_CONTACT_STENCIL_RESULT_FROZEN_PENDING_EXACT_BODY_HASH_ADOPTION

D2SW15_TASK624_FOUR_POINT_CONTACT_STENCIL_RESULT_BODY_BEGIN
SCOPE_AND_EXECUTION:
  One bounded manual analytic calculation was performed for the author-approved
  four-point stencil on one and the same prospective contact branch. No actual
  contact identity, owner, lift, T_loc or jet was invented. No Python, network,
  WallGo, project code, DEV, RC, official run, fit or numerical endpoint was
  used. This result computes exact relations implied by the invariant area
  coordinate and conditional passivity; it is not an M0-M8 member PASS.

FIXED_CONDITIONAL_BRANCH:
  Let I_e=(s_-,s_+) be the maximal connected component containing the reference
  state s=0 on which D0-D5 and M0-M8 would all hold for one fixed existing
  contact e, if such a member exists. Define
    Delta_s:=s_+-s_->0,
    A_-:=A_e(0) exp(s_-),
    A_+:=A_e(0) exp(s_+),
    r:=A_+/A_-=exp(Delta_s)>1.
  The endpoints are one-sided limits unless their own complete regular receipts
  prove membership. Finiteness of s_-,s_+ and existence of this branch are not
  assumed by the algebra below.

FOUR_POINT_STENCIL_CALCULATION:
  The approved normalized positions and deformation values are
    B_minus: x=0,   s -> s_- from above;
    M1:      x=1/3, s_1=s_-+Delta_s/3=(2s_-+s_+)/3;
    M2:      x=2/3, s_2=s_-+2Delta_s/3=(s_-+2s_+)/3;
    B_plus:  x=1,   s -> s_+ from below.
  Since A_e(s)=A_e(0) exp(s), their exact conditional areas are
    A_Bminus -> A_-,
    A_M1=A_- exp(Delta_s/3)=A_-^(2/3) A_+^(1/3),
    A_M2=A_- exp(2Delta_s/3)=A_-^(1/3) A_+^(2/3),
    A_Bplus -> A_+.
  Hence the four areas form an exact geometric stencil in the regular limit:
    A_M1/A_- = A_M2/A_M1 = A_+/A_M2 = r^(1/3),
    A_M1 A_M2 = A_- A_+,
    s_1+s_2=s_-+s_+.
  These identities introduce no new dimensional scale and remain invariant
  under coordinate change, surface reparametrization and state relabeling.

CONDITIONAL_RESPONSE_AND_PASSIVITY_CALCULATION:
  Only on a future branch where task611B proves the common response
    R_T,e(s)=R_Jg,e(s)=R_e(s)
  and c_e(s)=dR_e/ds may the three equal-log-area increments be written
    Delta R_1=integral_(s_- to s_1) c_e(s) ds,
    Delta R_2=integral_(s_1 to s_2) c_e(s) ds,
    Delta R_3=integral_(s_2 to s_+) c_e(s) ds.
  The integrals are one-sided limits at nonmember endpoints. Conditional
  passivity c_e>=0 implies
    Delta R_k>=0,
    R_Bminus<=R_M1<=R_M2<=R_Bplus.
  Where the response limits are finite, the exact interval-average capacities
  are
    cbar_k=(3/Delta_s) Delta R_k>=0.
  Strict ordering requires c_e>0 on a set of nonzero measure. No accepted input
  fixes any Delta R_k, cbar_k, finite upper capacity bound or numerical area.

BOUNDARY_AND_INTERIOR_STATUS:
  B_minus and B_plus are guard-touching one-sided probes. Each is an actual
  D_CR1a member only if the endpoint itself retains every D0-D5 and M0-M8
  receipt; otherwise it is not selected as a member and no failure is inferred.
  M1 and M2 are algebraically interior, but they are certified regular members
  only after the same actual Z/e/owner/lift/T_loc/full-jet receipts pass there.
  The stencil alone proves neither finite endpoints nor domain nonemptiness.

ORDERED_M0_M8_SCREEN:
  M0 requires one immutable actual receipt naming Z,e,I_Z(e), every incoming
  sign, the unique p_*, F_e,i_e,Gamma_e,C_W,xi_e and evaluated existing
  T_loc/current/geometry/source jets. No such receipt was supplied with the
  four-point approval. Therefore all four candidates stop at M0 as
    CR1A_MEMBER_MAP_WAITING / MISSING_ACTUAL_MEMBER_RECEIPT.
  M1-M8 are not reached and are neither passed nor failed. In particular the
  exact area stencil does not substitute for gluing, Landau, conservation,
  common-response, passivity-image, source-off, constant-rank or jet proofs.

EXACT_RESULT_AND_COUNTS:
  FOUR_POINT_INVARIANT_AREA_STENCIL_DERIVED=true.
  CONDITIONAL_PASSIVITY_ORDERING_DERIVED=true.
  CERTIFIED_D_CR1A_MEMBERS=0.
  MEMBER_MAP_WAITING=4.
  EXCLUDED_MEMBERS=0.
  M0_M8_TYPED_MEMBER_MAPS=0.
  APPLICABLE_TASK622_BRANCH=P1_CR1A_DOMAIN_MEMBER_WAITING_RANGE_CONDITIONAL_OPEN.
  This is not an emptiness result: the four formulas are candidate locations,
  while current evidence certifies neither their membership nor exclusion.

SMALLEST_REACTIVATION_INPUT:
  Supply one immutable actual receipt for either M1 or M2 first, because an
  interior point avoids assuming endpoint regularity. The receipt must include
  the task622 M0 data and finite derived s_-,s_+ or a certified bounded regular
  subinterval. After that, perform the already authorized memberwise M0-M8
  calculation on that one member. Boundary limits are evaluated only after the
  interior branch and its one-sided regular jets are certified.

NONCLAIMS_AND_TRACK_STATE:
  No actual contact, endpoint, response value, capacity value, common response,
  curve existence, NZ/Z0, K_bridge, Xi, kernel, I0/PK1, E_N, owner/reservoir
  selection, dynamics, observable, checkpoint, score/depth change or closure is
  inferred. C01-RW1, P5 and A2-K4 remain LIVE/WAITING. The result is frozen but
  not accepted until a fresh independent manual analytic result audit and main
  orchestrator decision.
```

```text
D2SW15_TASK627_FINITE_DOMAIN_RESULT_CORRECTION_BODY_BEGIN
CORRECTION_SCOPE:
  Task624 bytes and SHA remain immutable historical evidence. This delta replaces
  only its domain branch, four-point status/count wording and reactivation rule.
  No CR1-CR5 or M0-M8 calculation is repeated. All task624 equations survive only
  inside the finite-domain branch defined below.

DOMAIN_CERTIFICATE_PARTITION:
  Define F_max to mean a proof that the selected maximal regular component has
    s_-,s_+ in R and s_-<s_+.
  Define F_sub to mean an immutable receipt for one finite bounded regular
  subinterval J=(a,b), with a,b in R, a<b, contained in one selected regular
  component and carrying the same fixed contact/incidence/topology branch.
  The ordered proof partition is:
    1. if F_max, set (a,b)=(s_-,s_+) and endpoint_role=MAXIMAL_COMPONENT_LIMITS;
    2. else if F_sub, use its supplied (a,b) and
       endpoint_role=BOUNDED_SCAN_LIMITS_NOT_PHYSICAL_DOMAIN_BOUNDARIES;
    3. else return STENCIL_DOMAIN_WAITING before defining Delta_s, r, M1, M2,
       response increments or interval-average capacities.
  No failure to prove F_max or F_sub implies an empty contact domain.

FINITE_DOMAIN_ONLY_IDENTITIES:
  In branch 1 or 2 define Delta_s:=b-a in (0,infinity), A_a:=A_e(0)exp(a),
  A_b:=A_e(0)exp(b), r:=A_b/A_a=exp(Delta_s), and
    s_1:=a+Delta_s/3=(2a+b)/3,
    s_2:=a+2Delta_s/3=(a+2b)/3.
  Then exactly
    A_M1=A_a^(2/3)A_b^(1/3),
    A_M2=A_a^(1/3)A_b^(2/3),
    A_M1/A_a=A_M2/A_M1=A_b/A_M2=r^(1/3),
    A_M1*A_M2=A_a*A_b,
    s_1+s_2=a+b.
  These are coordinate/reparametrization/relabeling invariant and introduce no
  dimensional scale. In branch 2, B_minus and B_plus mean only the selected scan
  limits; they are not inferred to be physical lower/upper contact boundaries.

FINITE_DOMAIN_ONLY_RESPONSE_RESULT:
  Only if the same branch additionally proves one common response
    R_T,e=R_Jg,e=R_e, c_e=dR_e/ds>=0
  on J may one define the three finite-width integrals over
    [a,s_1], [s_1,s_2], [s_2,b].
  Their increments are nonnegative and imply
    R_a<=R_M1<=R_M2<=R_b.
  Finite response limits imply cbar_k=(3/Delta_s)Delta_R_k>=0.
  Strict ordering still requires c_e>0 on a set of nonzero measure. No response,
  capacity, endpoint or finite upper bound is supplied by this delta.

CORRECTED_STATUS_AND_COUNTS:
  Current accepted evidence proves neither F_max nor F_sub. Therefore the current
  executable result is
    STENCIL_DOMAIN_WAITING,
    CERTIFIED_D_CR1a_MEMBERS=0,
    INSTANTIATED_STENCIL_POINTS=0,
    EXCLUDED_MEMBERS=0,
    M0_M8_TYPED_MEMBER_MAPS=0.
  Conditionally, after F_max or F_sub is certified, exactly four stencil locations
  are defined and all four remain MEMBER_MAP_WAITING until their actual M0 receipts
  are provided. This conditional count is not the current instantiated count.

SMALLEST_REACTIVATION_INPUT:

  F_sub. Then supply one actual M0 receipt at M1 or M2 naming the same Z/e,
  incidence signs, unique owner, full lift, T_loc/current and complete geometry,

  memberwise M0-M8 calculation be considered; no new calculation is authorized by

NONCLAIMS_AND_TRACK_STATE:
```

```text
AUTHOR_INPUT_AND_SCOPE:
  Consider only existing same-ontology regular curves and contacts. For a finite
  scalar delta>0 define the scan interval and four labels
    J_delta=(-delta,2delta),
    B_minus: s approaches -delta from above,
    M1: s=0 with label Z(0),
    M2: s=delta with label Z(delta),
    B_plus: s approaches 2delta from below.
  The family is set-valued over the intersection of all existing regular guards.
  Its nonemptiness is not assumed. B_minus and B_plus are scan limits, never
  physical domain or guard boundaries without separate proof. Q1R6 is only an
  E3 base candidate and supplies no actual cellular-state membership by label.

CANDIDATE_FAMILY_AND_FINITE_SUBINTERVAL_CERTIFICATE:
  Let A_delta contain tuples (delta,Z(.),e,R_e) only when all of the following
  are proved on the complete open interval J_delta and by one-sided regular
  limits at its scan ends:
    F0 delta is a finite positive dimensionless number and s is the accepted
       invariant log-area coordinate of the same shared contact face;
    F1 Z(s) is one existing C2 same-ontology curve with fixed incidence,
       topology, contact identity e and one shared F_e/Sigma_prep primitive;
    F2 the full interval remains in the Type-I, unique-future-Landau,
       nondegenerate smooth regular domain and satisfies every G0-G8 guard;
    F3 existing B_rec fixes all incident signs and exactly one owner p_* with
       unchanged orientation and weight on the interval;
    F4 the full spacetime lift xi_s, swept Gamma_e and oriented worldtube C_W
       exist uniquely and every gluing, cap, side and corner identity holds;
    F5 existing T_loc, current and complete metric, normal, measure, embedding,
       source, Q_CT, stress-power, storage, moving-side and corner jets are
       evaluated, smooth and provenance-bound throughout the interval;
    F6 the full coupled constraint map has the required locally constant rank,
       conservation/Noether identities, passivity c_e>=0 and gauge descent.
  F_SUB_CERT(delta) means exactly one such tuple is immutably certified. The
  definition neither supplies a tuple nor turns missing evidence into emptiness.

INTERIOR_M0_RECEIPT:
  M0_BASE_CERT at M1 requires one immutable actual receipt naming Z(0), e,
  I_Z(e), every epsilon_(p,e), the unique p_*, F_e, i_e, Gamma_e, C_W, xi_s,
  evaluated existing T_loc/current and the complete full-jet provenance needed
  to start task622 M1-M8. It is a provenance/type certificate, not an M1-M8
  PASS. M0_M2_CERT requires the corresponding actual receipt at Z(delta) and is
  tested only after F_SUB_CERT and M0_BASE_CERT.

CONDITIONAL_FOUR_POINT_GEOMETRY:
  Only for a certified member of A_delta, the accepted finite-branch formulas
  give
    A_Bminus=A_0*exp(-delta),
    A_M1=A_0,
    A_M2=A_0*exp(delta),
    A_Bplus=A_0*exp(2delta),
  where A_0=A_e(0)>0 is the actual base face area from the same receipt. These
  formulas do not provide A_0, delta, a response value or a physical boundary.

FAIL_CLOSED_DECISION_ORDER:
  C0 contradictory invariant receipts for one Z/e ->
     MATERIAL_FINDING_INCONSISTENT_FSUB_M0_RECEIPT; select none;
  C1 no complete M0_BASE_CERT -> M0_BASE_RECEIPT_WAITING and stop before
     certifying any delta or evaluating M2;
  C2 M0_BASE_CERT exists but no proved F_SUB_CERT(delta) ->
     FSUB_RANGE_WAITING; distinguish underdetermination from a proved-empty set;
  C3 a universal proof excludes every finite delta>0 under the frozen guards ->
     FSUB_ALLOWED_SET_EMPTY_PROVED in that exact scope only;
  C4 M0_BASE_CERT and at least one F_SUB_CERT(delta) ->
     FSUB_CERTIFIED_WITH_M1_M0; then test M0_M2_CERT memberwise;
  C5 C4 plus M0_M2_CERT -> TWO_INTERIOR_M0_RECEIPTS_CERTIFIED.
  C3 is never inferred from a failed search. The first applicable branch is the
  result. No branch reaches task622 M1-M8, common response, NZ/Z0 or dynamics.

DONE_WHEN_AND_NONCLAIMS:
```
